83aa4558e3d2484898d76e1070654226f35af725.title: Terrain-Aware Thompson Sampling for Multi-Drone Search and Rescue
83aa4558e3d2484898d76e1070654226f35af725.comment: Accepted to the 18th International Symposium on Distributed Autonomous Robotic Systems (DARS 2026)
83aa4558e3d2484898d76e1070654226f35af725.summary: In this work, we propose a decentralized terrain-aware multi-drone Thompson Sampling algorithm tailored for search and rescue (SAR) applications. A probability distribution of locating a lost person is informed by terrain data, using established SAR models (displacement ring, elevation, watershed, dispersion angle, and track offset) derived from historical SAR case data on lost person behavior. Exploration is conducted by a team of drones using Thompson Sampling, where candidate actions are selected by drawing samples from this probability distribution, represented by a per-cell Gaussian posterior whose mean and variance are updated through Bayesian inference. This approach balances exploration of uncertain regions with exploitation of high-probability areas to locate a lost person. Observation uncertainty is incorporated through fractional forest coverage, which measures the percentage of an observation occluded by tree coverage and accounts for reduced detection performance in densely vegetated areas. Simulations using real SAR case data (YOSAR) evaluate the proposed method against a coverage planner and a probabilistic active search method in search regions of 1.5 and 3.8 square kilometers, with 5, 10, 15, and 20 agents flying at 50 km/hr. We demonstrate that our method achieves a success rate of approximately 87% within 60 to 247 seconds in the 1.5 square kilometer region, and success rates of approximately 75% to 91% within 161 to 466 seconds in the 3.8 square kilometer region, across different agent configurations.

AI.tldr: 面向多无人机搜救，提出去中心化、地形感知的 Thompson Sampling：用历史失踪者行为模型塑造逐格定位概率，以贝叶斯更新高斯后验并通过采样选择动作。YOSAR 案例仿真中报告 1.5 km² 区域成功率约 87%（60–247 秒），3.8 km² 区域约 75%–91%（161–466 秒）。
AI.motivation: 摘要的出发点是多无人机 SAR 需要在探索不确定区域与利用高概率区域之间平衡，同时考虑地形/历史失踪者行为以及树冠遮挡导致的探测性能下降。摘要未明确说明现有 coverage planner 或 probabilistic active search 的具体失败模式。
AI.method: 输入包括地形数据、由 YOSAR 历史案例导出的失踪者行为 SAR 模型，以及由森林覆盖率刻画的观测遮挡程度。方法为每个栅格维护高斯定位后验，用 Thompson Sampling 从后验采样来选择无人机候选动作，并通过贝叶斯推断更新各栅格的均值与方差；输出是去中心化的多机搜索动作序列/搜索过程。相较摘要中作为对照的 coverage planner 与 probabilistic active search，摘要强调的差异点是把地形先验和植被遮挡造成的观测不确定性纳入搜索决策。
AI.result: 在基于 YOSAR 真实案例数据的仿真中，评价指标为定位成功率与成功耗时，对照为 coverage planner 和 probabilistic active search；摘要未报告这两类基线的数值结果或相对提升。作者报告：1.5 km² 区域成功率约 87%，耗时 60–247 秒；3.8 km² 区域在不同无人机配置下成功率约 75%–91%，耗时 161–466 秒。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了 SAR 中“地形/历史行为先验 + 逐格贝叶斯信念更新 + Thompson Sampling 动作选择”的去中心化多机搜索回路，并把植被遮挡纳入观测不确定性。对具身智能/世界模型读者，摘要描述的是概率规划与信念更新路线，未报告学习式世界模型或端到端策略；证据边界是仅限 YOSAR 案例数据仿真、仅给出总体成功率与耗时范围，且未报告基线数值，因此不能据此推断真实部署优势或相对提升幅度。
AI.core_method: 把地形与历史案例先验变成逐格高斯定位后验，用 Thompson Sampling 采样选动作，并在贝叶斯更新中纳入森林覆盖率造成的观测不确定性。

key_results.finding: 在 1.5 平方公里区域，作者报告成功率约 87%，成功耗时为 60–247 秒。
key_results.setting: YOSAR 真实案例数据驱动的仿真；搜索区域 1.5 km²；5、10、15、20 架无人机，飞行速度 50 km/hr；与 coverage planner 和 probabilistic active search 对比，但摘要未报告基线数值。

key_results.finding: 在 3.8 平方公里区域，不同无人机配置下成功率约 75%–91%，成功耗时为 161–466 秒。
key_results.setting: YOSAR 真实案例数据驱动的仿真；搜索区域 3.8 km²；5、10、15、20 架无人机，飞行速度 50 km/hr；与 coverage planner 和 probabilistic active search 对比，但摘要未报告基线数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: success rates of approximately 75% to 91% within 161 to 466 seconds in the 3.8 square kilometer region, across different agent configurations

limitations: 摘要未报告作者声明的局限性，也未报告失败案例或方法失效条件。
摘要未报告 coverage planner 与 probabilistic active search 的数值结果、统计显著性或多随机种子结果，无法量化相对改进。

a01adabdfcd0118dbd934b3abc64356fc2436062.title: Input-output characterization of robotic grasping: Connecting design parameters to grasp behavior through the admittance
a01adabdfcd0118dbd934b3abc64356fc2436062.summary: Low-impedance grippers make the dynamics of a grasp matter. Current grasp metrics, however, are static: they describe how a held object resists constant loads, not how it responds to time-varying ones. To quantify this, we rely on small-signal analysis to characterize a grasp by its admittance, the transfer matrix relating load perturbations to object displacements around an equilibrium. This transfer matrix recovers the stiffness and stability of the grasp at zero frequency and captures its natural frequencies and peak gain under time-varying loads. We apply this characterization to a planar two-finger gripper under proportional-derivative control. We show that two grasps of the same object in the same position and with the same contact forces can differ in stiffness by two orders of magnitude. Likewise, two grasps that share the same stiffness can exhibit very different resonances. Nonlinear simulations confirm the effectiveness of our small-signal analysis in capturing the dynamic behavior of grasping.

AI.tldr: 现有抓取度量是静态的，只描述物体对恒定载荷的抵抗，无法刻画时变载荷下的动态响应；作者用小幅值（小信号）分析把抓取表征为一个导纳传递矩阵，并在平面两指 PD 控制夹爪上说明：物体、位置与接触力都相同的两种抓取，刚度可相差两个数量级，或刚度相同但共振差异很大。
AI.motivation: 低阻抗夹爪让抓取的动力学变得重要，而当前抓取度量是静态的：它们描述被持物体如何抵抗恒定载荷，而非如何响应时变载荷。摘要据此提出需要量化抓取的动态响应。
AI.method: 输入是抓取的受力—位移关系：作者用小幅值（小信号）分析，在平衡点附近把载荷扰动到物体位移的传递关系建模为导纳传递矩阵。该矩阵在零频率处给出抓取的刚度与稳定性，并刻画时变载荷下的固有频率与峰值增益。相对静态度量的基线，改变的是把“对恒定载荷的抵抗”替换为“对扰动的频率相关动态响应”。作者将该表征应用于一个采用比例—微分（PD）控制的平面两指夹爪，输出是对抓取动态行为的定量描述，而非单一的静态指标。
AI.result: 作者报告：同一物体、同一位置、相同接触力的两种抓取，刚度可相差两个数量级；刚度相同的两种抓取可以表现出非常不同的共振。非线性仿真确认该小信号分析能够捕捉抓取的动态行为。摘要未报告真实机器人实验，也未给出具体基准、SOTA 对比或精细数值（除“两个数量级”外）。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：把抓取评价从静态刚度扩展到频率相关的导纳，使设计参数与抓取在时变载荷下的行为（稳定裕度、共振）建立可解释的联系，这对低阻抗/柔顺抓取尤为相关。证据边界：结论基于平面两指 PD 控制夹爪与非线性仿真，摘要未报告真实世界验证。
AI.core_method: 在平衡点附近做小幅值（小信号）分析，把抓取建模为载荷扰动到物体位移的导纳传递矩阵，从而同时读出零频刚度/稳定性与时变载荷下的固有频率和峰值增益。

key_results.finding: 同一物体、同一位置、相同接触力的两种抓取，刚度可相差两个数量级。
key_results.setting: 平面两指夹爪，比例—微分（PD）控制，小幅值分析；摘要未报告真实机器人实验与具体刚度数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: We show that two grasps of the same object in the same position and with the same contact forces can differ in stiffness by two orders of magnitude.

key_results.finding: 刚度相同的两种抓取可以表现出非常不同的共振。
key_results.setting: 同上：平面两指夹爪，PD 控制；摘要未报告共振频率的具体数值或基线。
key_results.evidence_quote: Likewise, two grasps that share the same stiffness can exhibit very different resonances.

key_results.finding: 非线性仿真确认小信号分析能捕捉抓取的动态行为。
key_results.setting: 仿真层面的验证；摘要未报告真实机器人实验、样本量或对比基线。
key_results.evidence_quote: Nonlinear simulations confirm the effectiveness of our small-signal analysis in capturing the dynamic behavior of grasping.

limitations: 作者仅报告非线性仿真确认，摘要未报告真实机器人实验（摘要未报告）。
摘要未报告与既有静态抓取度量的定量对比、基准任务或 SOTA 数值（摘要未报告）。
方法仅在平面两指 PD 控制夹爪上演示，是否适用于其他抓取器/控制器或三维情形，摘要未报告（摘要未报告）。

5317d914398a132553e98e4db1400047a744f0ea.title: Can MLLMs Reason over Surround-View Driving Videos? A Multi-View Autonomous Driving QA Benchmark
5317d914398a132553e98e4db1400047a744f0ea.summary: Surround-view video understanding in autonomous driving is a crucial capability for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to achieve reliable driving reasoning. Real-world driving often requires information beyond the front-view camera. Existing MLLMs primarily focus on front-view information, while their spatio-temporal understanding and reasoning abilities remain unknown. To address this gap, we propose MVDriveBench, a high-information-density video QA benchmark for autonomous driving, characterized by synchronized surround-view inputs, spatio-temporal understanding, and reasoning-chain-oriented evaluation. We design 12 categories of QA tasks that cover the complete reasoning pipeline from low-level visual perception to high-level driving decision-making, enabling a systematic evaluation of MLLMs surround-view spatio-temporal understanding and reasoning capabilities in complex driving environments. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 23 open-source, closed-source, and expert MLLMs on MVDriveBench. The results show that current MLLMs still exhibit insufficient surround-view spatio-temporal reasoning ability. Meanwhile, closed-loop evaluations of specialist models in AlpaSim reveal a correlation between surround-view spatio-temporal reasoning capabilities and closed-loop driving performance, highlighting the importance of comprehensive multi-view understanding for reliable vehicle control.

AI.tldr: 作者提出 MVDriveBench：面向自动驾驶的环视（多视角同步）视频问答基准，覆盖从低层感知到高层驾驶决策的 12 类推理任务，并评测 23 个开源/闭源/专家 MLLM；结论是当前 MLLM 的环视时空推理能力仍不足，且摘要未报告任何数值结果。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出真实驾驶常需要前视相机之外的信息，而现有 MLLM 主要关注前视信息，其时空理解与推理能力"仍然未知"，缺少能系统性衡量的评测手段。这一缺口由基准与评测来填补，而非由新模型架构填补。
AI.method: 输入是同步的多视角（环视）驾驶视频及配套问答；MVDriveBench 以"高信息密度、同步环视输入、时空理解、面向推理链的评测"为特征，设计 12 类 QA 任务，覆盖从低层视觉感知到高层驾驶决策的完整推理链。方法产出是一个评测基准与评测协议：用它系统评测 23 个开源、闭源与专家 MLLM，并在 AlpaSim 中对专家模型做闭环评测，观察环视时空推理能力与闭环驾驶表现之间的关系。摘要未报告基准构建流程、数据规模或评测指标定义。
AI.result: 作者报告：在 MVDriveBench 上评测 23 个开源、闭源与专家 MLLM 后，当前 MLLM 的环视时空推理能力仍然不足；在 AlpaSim 中对专家模型的闭环评测显示，环视时空推理能力与闭环驾驶表现之间存在相关性。摘要未给出任何任务分数、指标数值、单位或与基线的定量比较，也未给出相关性强度。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型研究的含义是：可靠的车辆控制可能需要综合多视角的时空理解，因此评测应从单视角感知扩展到环视推理链与闭环驾驶表现的联合考察。证据边界：本文贡献为基准与评测，作者对 MLLM 能力的负面结论与"推理能力—闭环表现相关"的说法均为作者自述的定性结论，摘要未提供数值结果、闭环指标定义或场景条件，也未说明是否包含真实车辆部署。
AI.core_method: 构建同步环视驾驶视频的 12 类推理链式 QA 基准，用它统一评测多个 MLLM，并在 AlpaSim 中做闭环驾驶评测以关联推理能力与控制表现。

key_results.finding: 作者报告当前 MLLM 在环视时空推理上能力仍不足（无具体数值）。
key_results.setting: 在作者提出的 MVDriveBench 上评测 23 个开源、闭源与专家 MLLM；摘要未报告分数、指标、单位或基线对比。
key_results.evidence_quote: We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 23 open-source, closed-source, and expert MLLMs on MVDriveBench. The results show that current MLLMs still exhibit insufficient surround-view spatio-temporal reasoning ability.

key_results.finding: 作者报告专家模型在 AlpaSim 的闭环评测中，环视时空推理能力与闭环驾驶表现存在相关性（未报告相关系数或性能数值）。
key_results.setting: 对专家模型（specialist models）在 AlpaSim 中进行闭环评测；摘要未报告场景设置、闭环指标、硬件或相关性强度。
key_results.evidence_quote: Meanwhile, closed-loop evaluations of specialist models in AlpaSim reveal a correlation between surround-view spatio-temporal reasoning capabilities and closed-loop driving performance, highlighting the importance of comprehensive multi-view understanding for reliable vehicle control.

limitations: 作者自述的能力不足指向被评测模型（当前 MLLM 环视时空推理不足），并非本文方法自身的局限。
摘要未报告定量结果：没有任务准确率、指标数值、单位、基线对比或相关性强度，因此无法判断差距大小。
摘要未报告基准细节与实验条件：数据集规模与来源、12 类任务的具体构成与标注方式、评测指标定义、AlpaSim 闭环设置，以及是否涉及真实车辆验证。

033767c3ec4ab9da9b2c137c0533045e29e1af11.title: FloCOS: Predicting Compact Forward Occupancy Sets of Surrounding Vehicles via Conditional Flow Matching
033767c3ec4ab9da9b2c137c0533045e29e1af11.summary: Existing methods for predicting surrounding vehicles' forward occupancy may under-approximate the ground-truth occupancy, exposing the ego vehicle to collision risk, or produce overly conservative regions that unnecessarily restrict feasible space and cause planning failures. To address these issues, we propose FloCOS, a conditional flow-matching framework that predicts compact forward occupancy sets with high occupancy coverage. FloCOS represents the forward occupancy set as a time-varying union of half-space convex polygons parameterized by temporal basis coefficients. Conditional flow matching captures the conditional distribution of these coefficients to govern the temporal evolution of the convex components, trained under coverage and union-area losses that penalize missed occupancy and excess area. For downstream trajectory optimization, the predicted nonconvex union is directly incorporated into hyperplane-based collision-avoidance constraints. Evaluations on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset show that FloCOS generates compact forward occupancy sets with high coverage and achieves a higher interaction completion rate than evaluated baselines. Real-world vehicle experiments further confirm its ability to support collision-free planning in interactive scenarios.

AI.tldr: 针对周边车辆前向占据集预测中"覆盖不足导致碰撞风险"与"过度保守限制可行空间"的两难，FloCOS 用条件流匹配学习随时间演化的半空间凸多边形并集系数，在覆盖与并集面积损失下训练，并直接接入超平面碰撞约束的轨迹优化。作者报告在 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 上覆盖率高、占据集紧凑，且交互完成率高于所评估基线；真实车辆实验支持交互场景下的无碰撞规划。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，现有周边车辆前向占据预测方法要么欠近似真值占据、使自车暴露于碰撞风险，要么产生过度保守的区域，不必要地压缩可行空间并导致规划失败。因此需要一个既高覆盖又紧凑的占据集预测。
AI.method: 输入为预测周边车辆前向占据集的任务（摘要未给出具体输入编码方式）。方法把前向占据集表示为半空间凸多边形的时变并集，由时间基系数参数化；再用条件流匹配建模这些系数的条件分布，从而支配各凸分量随时间的演化。训练使用覆盖损失与并集面积损失，分别惩罚漏掉的占据与多余面积。输出是随时间变化的非凸占据并集，可直接作为超平面形式的碰撞避免约束嵌入下游轨迹优化。
AI.result: 摘要报告两项结果，均未给出数值：在 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 上，FloCOS 生成高覆盖率且紧凑的前向占据集，交互完成率高于所评估基线（基线未具名，无具体数值、单位或提升幅度）；真实车辆实验进一步表明其能支持交互场景下的无碰撞规划（无规模、指标或条件细节）。作者未声明 SOTA，也未报告量化对比。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能中的预测—规划耦合而言，该工作提出一种把预测占据集表示成可解析约束（半空间凸多边形并集）的思路，使占据预测可直接进入基于超平面的避碰优化，而非仅作为独立感知输出。证据边界是：仅摘要可得，覆盖、紧凑性与交互完成率均无数值，真实实验为定性描述，未报告基线名称、消融或统计显著性，因此无法判断相对提升的量级。
AI.core_method: 用条件流匹配学习参数化"半空间凸多边形时变并集"的时间基系数分布，并以覆盖与并集面积损失训练，使输出的非凸占据并集能直接转成超平面避碰约束。

key_results.finding: 在 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 上，FloCOS 生成高覆盖率的紧凑前向占据集，并获得高于所评估基线的交互完成率（摘要未给出数值、单位或提升幅度）。
key_results.setting: 任务：周边车辆前向占据集预测；数据集：Waymo Open Motion Dataset；基线：仅称"evaluated baselines"，未具名；具体指标数值与实验条件摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Evaluations on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset show that FloCOS generates compact forward occupancy sets with high coverage and achieves a higher interaction completion rate than evaluated baselines.

key_results.finding: 真实车辆实验进一步表明 FloCOS 能支持交互场景下的无碰撞规划（定性表述，无数值）。
key_results.setting: 真实车辆实验、交互场景；车辆数、场景数、指标数值与安全统计摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Real-world vehicle experiments further confirm its ability to support collision-free planning in interactive scenarios.

limitations: 摘要未报告作者声明的局限性（如失败情形、假设或适用边界）。
摘要未报告任何数值结果：覆盖程度、紧凑性（面积）与交互完成率均只有"high coverage""compact""higher"等定性/相对表述，无单位、无百分比或百分点数值。
摘要未报告基线名称、消融实验、统计显著性，也未报告真实车辆实验的规模与条件；摘要中"欠近似"与"过度保守"是既有方法的动机性描述，不是本文方法的自陈缺陷。

f16626419ddc90bbe90972d7fa821da06dccb2e6.title: Helping Hand: A Continuum Robotic Grasper for Traction in Single-Channel Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection
f16626419ddc90bbe90972d7fa821da06dccb2e6.summary: Endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) is a minimally invasive approach for removing large polyps from the colon and offers many benefits compared to other surgical approaches. However, ESD is technically very challenging to perform, leading to limited adoption by physicians. We propose the Helping Hand, a two-segment continuum robotic grasper that, together with an electrosurgical knife, enables tissue traction and cutting within a single 3.7 mm working channel. We achieve this functionality by creating a slot at the base of the Helping Hand that lets the electrosurgical knife extend out, enabling countertraction and cutting through one instrument lumen. We evaluate the Helping Hand's workspace and its ability to provide traction forces from different starting configurations. Finally, we demonstrate the full workflow by isolating and removing tissue in an ex vivo chicken thigh, illustrating the potential for the Helping Hand to help improve ESD procedures.

AI.tldr: 针对单通道内镜下黏膜剥离术（ESD）牵引难的问题，作者提出两段式连续体机器人抓取器 Helping Hand，在其根部开槽让电刀伸出，从而在一条 3.7 mm 工作通道内同时实现反向牵引与切割；摘要仅报告离体鸡腿上的全流程演示，未给出数值结果。
AI.motivation: ESD 是结肠大息肉切除的微创方式，相对其他手术方式有多项优势，但操作技术难度很高，导致医生采用率有限；现有工作通道受限，牵引与切割难以在同一通道内完成。
AI.method: 输入是单条 3.7 mm 内镜工作通道以及电外科刀。作者设计的 Helping Hand 是一个两段式连续体机器人抓取器，关键改动是在抓取器根部开一个槽，使电外科刀可以从该槽伸出；这样同一器械腔道内即可先由抓取器夹持组织产生反向牵引（countertraction），再由电刀完成切割。产出是可在单通道内执行的牵引—切割操作，作者随后评估其工作空间，并测试在不同初始构型下提供牵引力的能力，最后在离体鸡腿中完成组织分离与切除的完整流程演示。摘要未报告控制、驱动方式或具体实现细节。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何数值指标（如工作空间范围、牵引力数值、成功率或耗时），也未报告与基线方法的定量比较。作者只报告了定性结果：在离体鸡腿（ex vivo chicken thigh）上完成隔离并切除组织的完整工作流演示，并据此声称该器械有潜力改善 ESD 操作。此为作者自述结果，未经独立验证；摘要未报告体内或临床数据。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与医疗机器人方向的意义在于：以结构层面的改动（根部开槽）把牵引与切割两种功能压缩进单一 3.7 mm 通道，属于面向器械形态与通道约束的操作设计问题，而非学习型策略或世界模型。证据边界很窄——仅有离体组织上的工作流演示，摘要未给出量化性能、基线对比或活体验证，因此不能据此推断临床可用性或相对现有 ESD 器械的优势幅度。

key_results.evidence_quote: Finally, we demonstrate the full workflow by isolating and removing tissue in an ex vivo chicken thigh, illustrating the potential for the Helping Hand to help improve ESD procedures.

limitations: 作者自述的问题在于 ESD 本身技术难度高、医生采用有限，而非其方法被报告的缺陷；摘要未报告 Helping Hand 自身的失败模式或性能短板。
摘要未报告：工作空间与牵引力评估的具体数值、单位与测量条件，因此无法判断牵引能力是否满足临床需求。

402e75f7194655f73ce44ef81086a8b6cbe8f93c.title: Same-State Pairs Make One JEPA Proof of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis Vacuous
402e75f7194655f73ce44ef81086a8b6cbe8f93c.summary: In a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), the JEPA proof of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) assumes that every observation determines the world state and that a spectral gap makes minimizers unique up to rotation. Under the hard-whitening population objective, same-state positive pairs make the induced world kernel the identity: every centered whitened state function is a global minimizer, and, when $d_z-1\ge 2k$, two minimizers can have best-rotation squared residual $2k$. The uniqueness claim is conditional; for $k<d_z-1$, where $d_z$ is the number of world states, this limit makes its premise unsatisfiable, so the claim has no content there. The experiments that motivate it leave the assumption: a caption sees only part of an image, and the paper states no experiment meets its hypotheses exactly. The theorem does not reach those experiments, and for $k<d_z-1$ its idealized same-state limit is vacuous. One of the paper's four quantitative results survives: a gap-free lower bound. Its bound vanishes only at perfect scene-explained fraction; it bounds alignment error but cannot certify good-view alignment. A canonical frame is determined only up to a rotation and a latent permutation. Paired samples fix the relative frame at effective rank $k$; a global rotation remains. Component semantics fix the relative permutation only up to signs; value anchors fix it once the mixing frame is pinned. A resource--gauge ledger records which resource fixes which gauge.

AI.tldr: 该文针对某一 JEPA 框架下对柏拉图表示假设（PRH）的证明给出反例式分析：在 hard-whitening 总体目标与 same-state 正样本对下，世界核退化为恒等，最小解不再唯一；当 $k<d_z-1$ 时唯一性主张的前提不可满足，其理想化极限因而空洞，且摘要称所引实验均不精确满足该证明的假设。
AI.motivation: 该 JEPA 版 PRH 证明依赖两个假设：每个观测都能确定世界状态，以及存在 spectral gap 使最小解在旋转意义下唯一。作者指出，激励该证明的实验并不满足这些假设（caption 只看到图像的一部分），且摘要明确表示没有任何实验精确满足其假设，因此证明与其动机实验之间存在脱节。
AI.method: 输入是 hard-whitening 总体目标下的 same-state 正样本对设定。作者的分析表明，此时被诱导的世界核成为恒等，于是任何一个中心化白化状态函数都是全局最小解；在 $d_z-1\ge 2k$ 的条件下可以给出两个最小解，其最佳旋转平方残差为 $2k$，从而否定"最小解唯一（至多相差旋转）"的结论。作者随后刻画规范标架的规范自由度：全局旋转与潜在置换无法由样本对确定，配对样本只在有效秩 $k$ 上固定相对标架，分量语义只在符号意义下固定相对置换，值锚（value anchors）在混合标架被钉住后固定置换。输出是一份"资源—规范账本"，记录哪种资源固定哪一种规范，以及该证明的有效范围判定，而不是新的表示学习方法或新模型。
AI.result: 作者自述其结果主要是否证性的：在 hard-whitening 总体目标下，same-state 正样本对使诱导世界核为恒等，所有中心化白化状态函数都是全局最小解；当 $d_z-1\ge 2k$ 时两个最小解的最佳旋转平方残差可达 $2k$。唯一性主张是有条件的，在 $k<d_z-1$ 时前提不可满足，该极限下主张没有内容。作者称原论文四项定量结果中仅有一项幸存，即一个 gap-free 下界；该下界只在"场景可解释比例"完美时才消失，且只能界定对齐误差、不能证明 good-view 对齐。摘要未报告任何 benchmark、机器人实验或对照数值。
AI.conclusion: 对研究世界模型与 JEPA 表示学习的读者而言，该摘要的可用信息是：这一特定 PRH 证明的结论不应与其动机实验混为一谈，其唯一性主张只在 $k$ 与 $d_z$ 满足特定关系时才有内容，而幸存的下界只约束对齐误差、不保证语义上的 good-view 对齐。规范标架本身只能确定到旋转与潜在置换，需额外资源（配对样本、分量语义、值锚）才能逐步固定。以上均为作者在摘要中的主张，未经独立验证；该工作是否提供修正后的证明或实验验证，摘要未报告。
AI.core_method: 在 hard-whitening 总体目标下分析 same-state 正样本对的最小化解集合，构造非唯一性实例并清点各类规范自由度。

key_results.finding: 在该目标下，same-state 正样本对使诱导的世界核成为恒等，所有中心化白化状态函数都是全局最小解；在 $d_z-1\ge 2k$ 时两个最小解的最佳旋转平方残差可达 $2k$，唯一性不成立。

limitations: 作者自述的弱点：所引实验脱离了证明假设（caption 只看到图像的一部分），摘要称没有任何实验精确满足其假设，因此定理无法覆盖这些实验。

9670981e5c0faae44e1f5196f989882a39537e06.title: An Integrated Architecture for Data-Efficient Real-Time Neural Imitation of Nonlinear Time-Optimal Model Predictive Control
9670981e5c0faae44e1f5196f989882a39537e06.summary: Nonlinear time-optimal model predictive control (TOMPC) enables highly performant control of constrained systems, but its computational cost prohibits real-time use on fast dynamical systems. Neural network imitation of the TOMPC control law can reduce online computational costs, yet existing work mostly targets quadratic cost formulations in simulation and addresses the challenges of neural controllers in isolation. This work imitates a long-horizon nonconvex TOMPC with hard terminal constraints, whose high computational cost limits training-data generation. We present (i) \emph{self-informed sampling (SIFS)}, a data-efficient expert-sampling strategy that uses a learned time-to-go to query the expert only where the policy deviates from time-optimal behavior, (ii) a complete training and control architecture that jointly addresses dataset correlation, suboptimal expert labels, covariate shift, constraint satisfaction and model mismatch, and (iii) real-world validation on a Furuta pendulum. SIFS matches standard dataset aggregation performance in roughly one-third of the training time and with less than half the training data. The resulting controller matches the region of attraction of the expert TOMPC while raising the control frequency from 1.4~Hz to 1~kHz. On hardware, the controller swings up and stabilizes the pendulum along trajectories closely matching the expert TOMPC solution.

AI.tldr: 针对长时域非凸、带硬终端约束的 TOMPC 计算昂贵、难以实时的问题，作者用“学习到的时间-to-go”只在策略偏离时间最优处查询专家（SIFS），并配套完整训练/控制架构。作者报告 SIFS 用约三分之一训练时间、不到一半数据达到标准数据集聚合的水平，控制器在 Furuta 摆硬件上以 1 kHz 复现专家 TOMPC 的吸引域并完成摆起稳摆。
AI.motivation: 非线性时间最优 MPC 性能好，但计算成本使其无法在快速动力学系统上实时运行；已有神经网络模仿工作多针对二次代价、且停留在仿真，并把神经控制器的各项挑战分开处理。本文所模仿的长时域非凸 TOMPC 带硬终端约束，计算代价高，进一步限制了训练数据生成。
AI.method: 输入是受约束系统的状态（Furuta 摆），监督信号来自长时域非凸 TOMPC 专家求解出的时间最优控制量。方法先学一个“剩余时间（time-to-go）”预测器，用它在策略偏离时间最优行为的状态附近才去查询昂贵专家，从而把采样集中在关键区域（SIFS）；再配一套联合处理数据相关性、次优专家标签、协变量偏移、约束满足与模型失配的训练与控制流程。输出是一个可高频在线运行的神经控制器，替代在线求解 TOMPC。
AI.result: 作者报告：SIFS 在约三分之一训练时间和不到一半训练数据下达到与标准数据集聚合（dataset aggregation）相当的性能（摘要未给出具体数值与指标定义）；神经控制器的吸引域与专家 TOMPC 一致，并把控制频率从 1.4 Hz 提升到 1 kHz；硬件上控制器完成 Furuta 摆的摆起与稳定，轨迹与专家 TOMPC 解接近（摘要未给出轨迹误差数值）。摘要未报告与其它神经模仿基线的定量对比、约束违反率或模型失配的量化结果。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型方向的意义在于：用数据高效的专家采样加完整训练管线，可以把在线不可解的非线性时间最优 MPC 蒸馏成 kHz 级神经控制器，并在真实硬件上保留专家的吸引域与轨迹行为。但证据边界很窄——单一 Furuta 摆硬件验证、仅与 dataset aggregation 对照、关键指标多为定性或近似描述，且约束满足与模型失配处理的实际效果未在摘要中量化，因此不能据此推断方法可推广到其它快速动力学系统或更高维任务。

key_results.finding: SIFS 在约三分之一训练时间、不到一半训练数据下，达到与标准数据集聚合相当的性能（相对量，非百分点；摘要未给具体数值）。
key_results.setting: 模仿长时域非凸、带硬终端约束的 TOMPC；对照基线为标准 dataset aggregation；摘要未报告具体数据集规模、任务指标定义与硬件条件。
key_results.evidence_quote: SIFS matches standard dataset aggregation performance in roughly one-third of the training time and with less than half the training data.

key_results.finding: 所得控制器的吸引域（region of attraction）与专家 TOMPC 一致，同时控制频率由 1.4 Hz 提升至 1 kHz。
key_results.setting: 所得神经控制器 vs 专家 TOMPC；实时验证平台为摘要所述的 Furuta 摆（摘要未明确该频率测量的具体条件）。
key_results.evidence_quote: The resulting controller matches the region of attraction of the expert TOMPC while raising the control frequency from 1.4~Hz to 1~kHz.

key_results.finding: 硬件上控制器完成摆起并稳定 Furuta 摆，轨迹与专家 TOMPC 解接近（定性表述，摘要未给跟踪误差数值）。
key_results.setting: Furuta 摆真实硬件实验，对照专家 TOMPC 解；摘要未报告样本量、重复次数或定量误差指标。
key_results.evidence_quote: On hardware, the controller swings up and stabilizes the pendulum along trajectories closely matching the expert TOMPC solution.

limitations: 作者未在摘要中报告具体数值结果（如训练时间、数据量、吸引域大小、轨迹误差、约束违反率），“约三分之一”“不到一半”为近似表述。
真实世界验证仅涉及一个 Furuta 摆平台；摘要未说明是否在其它系统或更复杂动力学上验证。
摘要未报告与其它神经模仿方法（除标准 dataset aggregation 外）的对比，也未给出消融或各架构组件贡献的量化证据。

0951ac7c8c8ec456bf8aef9387ac52526f1dfe88.title: Epigraph Form Reinforcement Learning-based Safe Trajectory Tracking Control for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles
0951ac7c8c8ec456bf8aef9387ac52526f1dfe88.summary: Safe trajectory tracking (STT) aims to enable autonomous vehicles to follow a reference trajectory accurately while avoiding collisions. This problem is particularly challenging for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) in highly dynamic environments. Existing non-learning-based STT methods often use simplified vehicle and interaction models to meet real-time requirements, which may result in suboptimal tracking accuracy. Although Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) can help address this limitation, widely used Lagrangian DRL methods often suffer from unstable training because increasing Lagrange multipliers amplify policy-gradient magnitudes. To address these issues, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework for STT, called STT Control Epigraph Form RL (STTC-EFRL). In this framework, the STT problem is formulated as an epigraph-form min-max optimization problem. Based on this formulation, we develop a learning mechanism that uses a decreasing scalar related to the epigraph to adjust the policy gradient descent direction without increasing the gradient magnitude, thereby improving training stability. We also develop a computationally efficient ray-casting method to compute a polyhedron scaling factor for safety quantification. Experimental results, including Vehicle-in-the-Loop tests, show that STTC-EFRL achieves higher tracking accuracy than the considered non-learning-based baseline and more stable training than widely used Lagrangian DRL methods, while satisfying safety requirements in connected environments.

AI.tldr: 面向网联自动驾驶车辆的安全轨迹跟踪（STT），作者提出 epigraph 形式的强化学习框架 STTC-EFRL，把 STT 写成 epigraph 形式的 min-max 优化，并用与 epigraph 相关的递减标量调整策略梯度下降方向而不放大梯度幅度，以改善训练稳定性。作者报告在包含 Vehicle-in-the-Loop 的实验中，其跟踪精度高于所对比的非学习基线，训练比常用的 Lagrangian DRL 更稳定，并满足网联环境下的安全要求（摘要未给出数值）。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出两个具体缺口：一是现有非学习型 STT 方法为满足实时性，常采用简化的车辆与交互模型，可能导致跟踪精度次优；二是 DRL 虽可弥补该局限，但广泛使用的 Lagrangian DRL 方法因 Lagrange 乘子增大而放大策略梯度幅度，导致训练不稳定。
AI.method: 输入是自动驾驶车辆在高度动态网联环境中的安全轨迹跟踪问题（跟随参考轨迹并避免碰撞）。方法改变的是优化形式与梯度更新方式：把 STT 建模为 epigraph 形式的 min-max 优化问题，在该形式下设计学习机制，用一个与 epigraph 相关的递减标量来调整策略梯度下降方向，而不是通过增大梯度幅度来施加约束。方法还设计了一种计算高效的 ray-casting 方法，用于计算多面体缩放因子以量化安全性。输出是一个满足安全要求的轨迹跟踪控制策略（摘要未报告网络结构、仿真器、训练数据规模等实现细节）。
AI.result: 作者报告（对比对象：所考虑的非学习型基线、广泛使用的 Lagrangian DRL 方法）：跟踪精度更高、训练更稳定，并在网联环境下满足安全要求；实验包含 Vehicle-in-the-Loop 测试。摘要未报告任何数值指标，因此无法给出具体的精度、安全率或训练曲线数值；这属于作者自述结论，未经独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型读者而言，该工作的可迁移要点是用 epigraph 形式的 min-max 表述替代常见的 Lagrangian 约束松弛机制，从而在施加安全约束时改变梯度方向而非梯度幅度；安全性量化的 polyhedron 缩放因子由 ray-casting 计算。证据边界：摘要只给出定性比较与 ViL 测试这一测试形式，未报告数值、具体基线名称、仿真与实车的划分细节，故不能据此判断相对提升幅度或真实道路部署表现。
AI.core_method: 把安全轨迹跟踪写成 epigraph 形式的 min-max 优化，用一个随 epigraph 递减的标量调节策略梯度下降方向（而非增大梯度幅度），并用 ray-casting 求多面体缩放因子来量化安全。

eec330ba00259539d4bf07893ef5853f4bd062c7.title: Collaborative Task Allocation for Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Systems Through Iterative Clustering
eec330ba00259539d4bf07893ef5853f4bd062c7.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) and presented at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
eec330ba00259539d4bf07893ef5853f4bd062c7.summary: Multi-robot systems face the challenge of efficiently allocating teams of heterogeneous robots to tasks. The task allocation problem is complicated by collaborative interactions between robots where teams of robots develop emergent capabilities that enable them to complete tasks that would be inefficient or impossible for individual robots. To address these challenges, we present an iterative clustering algorithm for collaborative task allocation in heterogeneous multi-robot systems. This approach partitions the computationally intractable global optimization problem into smaller, tractable subproblems by iteratively forming clusters of robots and tasks, then optimizing assignments within each cluster. By ensuring robots remain clustered with their currently assigned tasks, we guarantee monotonic improvement in overall utility with each iteration. We analyze the convergence of the algorithm and characterize how cluster size constraints determine which suboptimal assignments could trap the algorithm. In simulation, iterative clustering consistently outperforms simulated annealing, and a group-based auction in both computation time and solution quality, and outperforms a hedonic game approach in solution quality.

6e277fedaf6cdffd4802fbdc7a592ac644887e21.title: CT-SGAL-LIO: Causal Continuous Time Refinement of Discrete LiDAR Inertial Odometry
6e277fedaf6cdffd4802fbdc7a592ac644887e21.summary: State-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial odometry methods, including those on richer state manifolds, achieve strong global accuracy, yet their pose stream alternates between propagation and correction and can oscillate over short horizons even when globally accurate. Most existing methods follow these approaches: they either modify the filter to enable faster updates or estimate a continuous-time trajectory from raw LiDAR and inertial data. The latter involves extra optimization, delaying state updates and becoming less robust during rapid rotations or accelerations. We propose CT-SGAL-LIO, a continuous-time refinement module that smooths the posterior pose stream of a discrete SGal(3) estimator without modifying the estimator itself. The key novelty is to perform continuous-time trajectory refinement directly on the projected SGal(3) posterior: we fit a cubic trajectory over a bounded window of recent poses and evaluate it at a small fixed lag. This places the query time within the observed interval, so the refined pose is obtained by interpolation rather than extrapolation, while preserving causal operation. CT-SGAL-LIO improves relative trajectory accuracy on 17 sequences from three public benchmarks. Across 17 sequences from GRAND-TOUR, MCD, and GEODE, CT-SGAL-LIO improves short-term motion accuracy while largely preserving global accuracy. RTE improves by up to 70% on GRAND-TOUR and on all seven GEODE sequences, with 9.9-51.1% reductions. A 19.5-min R-Campus run also reduces posterior jumps by 85.4% with only a 4.7 mm change in the end-to-start gap. We plan to release our source code and results to support community validation and reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 针对全局精度高但短时姿态流会振荡的 LiDAR-惯性里程计，作者提出一个不修改原离散 SGal(3) 估计器的因果连续时间后处理模块：在最近位姿窗口上拟合三次轨迹并在固定小延迟处插值。作者报告在 17 个公开基准序列上提升相对轨迹精度，RTE 最高下降 70%，R-Campus 运行中后验跳变减少 85.4%。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出：现有 LiDAR-惯性里程计即使全局精度强，姿态流仍会在传播与校正之间交替，并在短时间尺度上振荡。已有做法要么修改滤波器以加快更新，要么直接从原始 LiDAR 与惯性数据估计连续时间轨迹；后者需要额外优化，延迟状态更新，并在快速旋转或加速时鲁棒性下降。摘要所指向的空缺是：不修改原估计器，仅对其后验位姿流做因果连续时间细化。
AI.method: 输入是离散 SGal(3) 估计器输出的投影后验位姿流。方法不修改该估计器本身，而是在一个近期位姿的有界窗口上拟合三次轨迹，并在小固定延迟处对该轨迹求值。由于查询时刻落在已观测区间内，细化位姿来自插值而非外推，因此保持因果操作。输出是平滑后的后验位姿流/细化位姿。

2fc168a4280fe9fc696a75b3dc768a5afc6f50f7.title: Marginal-Preserving Coupled Diffusion Composition for Long-Horizon Planning
2fc168a4280fe9fc696a75b3dc768a5afc6f50f7.summary: Compositional diffusion planners extend short-horizon trajectory models to long-horizon goal-conditioned planning by generating and stitching multiple local trajectory chunks. However, in multimodal environments, local plausibility is not sufficient for global consistency: independently initialized chunks may denoise toward incompatible overlap modes, producing plans that are individually feasible but incoherent after stitching. Existing remedies typically add search, guidance, pruning, or graph-based structure at inference time, increasing computational cost or relying on task-specific machinery. We instead investigate graph-structured dependence among chunk-wise initial diffusion noises as a lightweight coordination mechanism for compositional trajectory planning. We propose \textbf{M}arginal-Preserving \textbf{C}oupled \textbf{D}iffusion \textbf{C}omposition (MCDC), a training-free inference method for pretrained compositional diffusion planners. Instead of sampling chunk noises independently, MCDC constructs coupled Gaussian initializations whose per-chunk marginals remain exactly standard Gaussian, as required by the pretrained denoiser, while neighboring chunks receive positively correlated noise components. This preserves the standard-Gaussian initialization marginal of each chunk while biasing adjacent chunks toward compatible overlap-mode choices. We prove exact marginal preservation and show, under a simple multimodal overlap model, that positive coupling increases the probability of compatible mode selection. On OGBench long-horizon stitch tasks, MCDC consistently improves over independent compositional diffusion sampling while retaining nearly the same inference time, and achieves a favorable success--cost trade-off compared with search-based composition methods.

AI.tldr: 针对组合式扩散规划中独立初始化的轨迹片段可能去噪到互不兼容的重叠模态、拼接后不连贯的问题，作者提出免训练推理方法 MCDC：保持每个片段初始噪声的边缘分布为标准高斯，同时让相邻片段噪声正相关，从而偏向兼容的模态选择。作者报告在 OGBench 长时域 stitch 任务上持续优于独立组合扩散采样，且推理时间几乎不变。
AI.motivation: 组合式扩散规划器通过生成并拼接多个局部轨迹片段，把短时域轨迹模型扩展到长时域目标条件规划。但在多模态环境中，局部可行并不等于全局一致：独立初始化的片段可能去噪到互不兼容的重叠模态，产生单独可行、拼接后却不连贯的规划。现有补救办法（搜索、引导、剪枝、图结构）通常在推理时增加计算成本，或依赖任务专用机制。
AI.method: 输入是预训练的组合式扩散规划器以及各片段的初始高斯噪声；方法不训练、不改动去噪器，只改动初始化采样方式。MCDC 不再独立采样每个片段的噪声，而是构造耦合高斯初始化：每个片段的边缘分布仍严格保持标准高斯（满足预训练去噪器的要求），同时相邻片段在噪声分量上正相关。输出仍由原去噪器生成，但相邻片段被偏向选择彼此兼容的重叠模态，从而拼接更连贯。相对基线（独立采样片段噪声、必要时再加搜索/引导等推理期机制），变化只发生在初始噪声的依赖结构上。
AI.result: 作者报告：在 OGBench 长时域 stitch 任务上，MCDC 相比独立组合扩散采样持续提升，且推理时间几乎相同；相比基于搜索的组合方法，取得更有利的成功率—成本权衡。摘要未报告任何数值（成功率、提升幅度、推理时间均无数值）。理论部分：作者证明精确的边缘保持，并在一个简单多模态重叠模型下说明正耦合提高兼容模态被选中的概率，摘要同样未给数值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提示：长时域组合规划中的片段协调可以只放在初始噪声的依赖结构上，而不必在推理期引入搜索、引导或任务专用机制，对成本敏感的组合式扩散规划有参考价值。证据边界明确：全部结论均为作者自述且无独立验证；摘要未给出任何数值结果、消融或统计显著性；理论保证仅在简化的多模态重叠模型下成立；摘要也未说明评测是仿真还是真机。
AI.core_method: 不改动预训练去噪器，只把各轨迹片段的独立高斯初始噪声换成耦合高斯噪声：每个片段的边缘分布仍严格为标准高斯，相邻片段的噪声分量正相关，使相邻片段倾向于选择兼容的重叠模态。

8ccab4ad63d8176586d3b7d0a25c41e4dc58177b.title: Informative Path Planning with Gaussian Processes: Error Bounds, Algorithms, and Benchmarks
8ccab4ad63d8176586d3b7d0a25c41e4dc58177b.summary: Accurate environmental monitoring relies on Informative Path Planning (IPP) to deploy autonomous systems that maximize information gain. While Gaussian Processes (GPs) provide a robust mathematical foundation for modeling the environment, contemporary IPP approaches remain hindered by heuristic operational constraints and the lack of simultaneous theoretical guarantees for worst-case estimation error and approximation quality. Rather than introducing yet another heuristic, this paper presents a rigorous theoretical analysis of existing error bounds and algorithms to further develop the mathematical foundation for IPP. By evaluating probabilistic and deterministic bounds on reconstruction error, we establish that predictive variance is the theoretically ideal optimization objective for GP-based IPP. Furthermore, we analyze GreedyCover, a recent approach for optimizing predictive variance, and demonstrate that its near-optimal approximation guarantee matches the fundamental hardness-of-approximation limit for the problem. Comprehensive benchmarking confirms that this approach delivers superior estimation accuracy and computational efficiency compared to prominent information-theoretic objectives and optimization methods used in IPP. Finally, this theoretical analysis establishes a rigorous, near-optimal foundation for discrete offline IPP under bounded uncertainty constraints, offering clear and principled guidance for future work in continuous-space and online formulations.

AI.tldr: 该文不提出新启发式方法，而是对 GP 型信息路径规划（IPP）的误差界与算法做理论分析，论证预测方差是理论上理想的优化目标，并证明 GreedyCover 的近最优近似保证已达到该问题的近似硬度极限；基准测试称其在估计精度与计算效率上优于常见信息论目标与优化方法（未给出数值）。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，尽管高斯过程（GP）为环境建模提供了稳健的数学基础，当代 IPP 方法仍受启发式操作约束的限制，且缺少对最坏情况估计误差与近似质量的同时理论保证。
AI.method: 输入是 GP 建模下的环境监测式 IPP 问题设定：作者评估重建误差的概率界与确定性界，据此推导出预测方差是 GP 型 IPP 的理论理想优化目标；随后把 GreedyCover（一个近期用于优化预测方差的方法）作为分析对象，考察其近似保证，并与该问题的近似硬度极限做对比；最后在统一设定下对若干信息论目标与优化方法做基准测试。相对被描述的现状（依赖启发式操作约束、缺乏同时的理论保证），本文的"改动"不是引入新算法，而是给出理论刻画并把既有 GreedyCover 定位为达到硬度极限的近最优方案，输出是对离散离线 IPP 的近最优理论基础的整理与后续研究方向指引。

1e4c43ad47ad5998efac4d9128575cd4a5178a19.title: IncR-3DSGG: Incremental Posed RGB Image Based 3D Scene Graph Generation via Privileged Depth Supervision
1e4c43ad47ad5998efac4d9128575cd4a5178a19.summary: Scene graphs provide a compact, structured representation of environments by capturing objects and their spatial or semantic relationships in a form suitable for embodied agents. Existing 3D scene graph generation methods often rely on depth sensing at inference, either to associate object instances across views via point cloud overlap or to compute inter-object relations from geometric cues, limiting deployment to platforms with depth sensors. We propose IncR-3DSGG, which builds 3D scene graphs incrementally from posed\footnote{RGB images with camera extrinsics estimated by an off-the-shelf visual SLAM system.} RGB images, eliminating the use of depth sensors at inference. Our method leverages a Parametric Relation Predictor (PRP) that learns to estimate pairwise distances and relative angles between objects from 2D visual features and 2D geometric cues, using 3D geometric supervision available only during training. These learned pairwise measurements are fused across views through Pose Graph Optimization (PGO)~\cite{grisetti2010tutorial} to recover metrically grounded 3D object positions and build a globally consistent 3D scene graph incrementally. On the real-world 3RScan~\cite{wald2019rio} dataset, our method attains $52.2$ mean object recall and $30.8$ mean predicate recall under the 3DSSG~\cite{wald2020learning} evaluation protocol, against $27.0$ and $17.6$ for MonoSSG~\cite{wu2023incremental}, while using no depth or reconstructed geometry at inference. This shows that relations and metrically grounded 3D object representations can be predicted from posed RGB images alone.

AI.tldr: 为摆脱推理期对深度传感器的依赖，IncR-3DSGG 从带位姿的 RGB 图像增量构建 3D 场景图：关系预测器从 2D 特征与几何线索估计物体间距离和相对角，再经位姿图优化融合多视角。作者在 3RScan/3DSSG 协议报告平均物体召回 52.2、平均谓词召回 30.8，高于 MonoSSG 的 27.0 和 17.6，且推理不用深度或重建几何。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 场景图生成方法在推理时依赖深度传感：或用点云重叠跨视角关联物体实例，或从几何线索计算物体间关系，因而把部署限制在有深度传感器的平台上。作者希望仅用带位姿 RGB 图像完成增量式 3D 场景图构建。
AI.method: 输入是带相机外参的 RGB 图像，外参由现成视觉 SLAM 系统估计。核心变化是用参数化关系预测器（PRP）从 2D 视觉特征和 2D 几何线索学习物体间的成对距离与相对角；3D 几何只作为训练期监督，不在推理时输入。随后把这些跨视角的成对测量通过位姿图优化融合，恢复具有度量尺度的 3D 物体位置，并增量生成全局一致的 3D 场景图，输出物体及其空间/语义关系。
AI.result: 作者报告：在真实世界 3RScan 数据集、3DSSG 评测协议下，方法取得 52.2 平均物体召回和 30.8 平均谓词召回；对比方法 MonoSSG 分别为 27.0 和 17.6。作者同时说明推理阶段不使用深度或重建几何。摘要未报告百分比符号、方差、统计显著性、延迟或真实机器人部署结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，在作者设定的条件下，3D 场景图中的物体关系与度量化 3D 物体位置可由带位姿 RGB 图像预测，推理时无需深度传感器或重建几何，这对仅配备单目相机、依赖视觉 SLAM 位姿的具身平台具有潜在意义。证据边界是：结果仅来自真实世界 3RScan 数据集和 3DSSG 评测协议，未报告真实机器人部署、推理效率、SLAM 位姿误差影响或多数据集验证，因此不能据摘要推断更广泛的泛化能力。

key_results.finding: 在真实世界 3RScan 数据集、3DSSG 评测协议下，方法取得 52.2 平均物体召回和 30.8 平均谓词召回；MonoSSG 为 27.0 和 17.6，且方法推理时不使用深度或重建几何。
key_results.setting: 真实世界 3RScan 数据集；3DSSG 评测协议；对比基线为 MonoSSG；推理输入为带位姿 RGB 图像，不使用深度或重建几何。摘要未报告 MonoSSG 的输入条件、硬件或延迟。
key_results.evidence_quote: On the real-world 3RScan~\cite{wald2019rio} dataset, our method attains $52.2$ mean object recall and $30.8$ mean predicate recall under the 3DSSG~\cite{wald2020learning} evaluation protocol, against $27.0$ and $17.6$ for MonoSSG~\cite{wu2023incremental}, while using no depth or reconstructed geometry at inference.

limitations: 作者明确说明训练阶段仍使用 3D 几何监督，只有推理阶段不用深度；因此这不是完全无 3D 监督的方法。
方法依赖现成视觉 SLAM 提供相机外参；摘要未报告 SLAM 位姿误差、尺度漂移或跟踪失败对场景图质量的影响。
摘要未报告推理延迟、算力/内存开销、真实机器人部署、场景数量、重复实验或统计显著性；结果仅限 3RScan 与 3DSSG 协议。

fd70e3451b727c4f68783011789383144f3e3017.title: Spatial Foundry: A Multimodal Dataset for Spatial Intelligence
fd70e3451b727c4f68783011789383144f3e3017.summary: Spatial intelligence requires connecting visual observations to the geometry, objects, and persistent state of an environment. Images alone leave these relationships implicit, while disconnected annotations make it difficult to study appearance, camera motion, and scene changes under a common reference. We introduce Spatial Foundry, a collection of 5,280 furnished residential 3D scene configurations with editable assets and aligned visual, geometric, and temporal data. Its modalities include floor plans, perspective and panoramic RGB, metric depth, point clouds, meshes, instance-level 3D bounding boxes, and camera trajectories paired with video. Shared scene coordinates link observations across views and time; editable source scenes enable additional camera paths and controlled object changes. We describe the data representation and construction workflow, and discuss applications in floor-plan-conditioned 3D generation, geometric reconstruction, instance-level perception, camera-conditioned video generation, shared world modeling, and scene editing. Controlled camera and scene variations support spatial perception and world-model research. The public project page provides videos and an interactive colored point-cloud preview.

AI.tldr: 针对图像与离散标注难以在统一参照下关联外观、相机运动与场景变化的问题，作者构建 Spatial Foundry 数据集，覆盖 5,280 个带家具住宅 3D 场景配置并对齐视觉、几何与时间模态。摘要未报告定量评测结果。
AI.motivation: 空间智能需要把视觉观测连接到环境的几何、物体和持久状态；仅用图像时这些关系是隐式的，而彼此分离的标注难以用共同参照研究外观、相机运动和场景变化。
AI.method: 作者构建一个多模态 3D 场景数据集：以带家具住宅场景及可编辑资产为来源，提供平面图、透视与全景 RGB、度量深度、点云、网格、实例级 3D 包围盒，以及配视频的相机轨迹。共享场景坐标把不同视角和时刻的观测关联起来；可编辑源场景用于生成额外相机路径和受控物体变化。产出是数据集、数据表示与构建流程说明，以及项目页的视频和交互式彩色点云预览。
AI.result: 摘要未报告准确率、FID、成功率等定量评测，也未报告基线对比、消融或真实机器人实验。作者报告的数据集规模为 5,280 个带家具住宅 3D 场景配置；没有声称 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把空间感知和世界模型研究所需的视觉、几何与时间信号放进同一场景参照系，并通过可控相机/物体变化支持 floor-plan 条件 3D 生成、几何重建、实例级感知、相机条件视频生成、共享世界建模和场景编辑等应用。证据限于摘要：尚无定量性能或部署结论。
AI.core_method: 将同一场景的视觉、几何与时间观测对齐到共享场景坐标，并用可编辑源场景生成新相机路径与受控物体变化。

key_results.finding: Spatial Foundry 包含 5,280 个带家具住宅 3D 场景配置，并附带可编辑资产与对齐的视觉、几何、时间数据。

limitations: 摘要未报告定量评测指标、基线比较、消融或统计显著性；不能据此判断方法相对既有数据集的性能。

087d83a3f560321d65f7dbce35ba70b80cc9c96a.title: Topology-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Egocentric Videos
087d83a3f560321d65f7dbce35ba70b80cc9c96a.summary: Reconstructing dynamic scenes and objects from monocular egocentric video is crucial for embodied AI, yet existing 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) approaches struggle with everyday interactions involving topological changes, such as cutting, assembly, opening, or closing. Since 4DGS methods rely on deforming a fixed representation, events that split, merge, or reveal surfaces cause severe visual artifacts. To address this challenge, we introduce TopoEgo, the first benchmark dedicated to topological changes in egocentric video (covering fission, fusion, open, and close), alongside Topo-4DGS, a topology-aware reconstruction method. Topo4DGS jointly models part-level motion and time-varying surface support by assigning independent rigid transformations to interacting parts and dynamically activating or deactivating Gaussians as surfaces appear, disappear, or separate. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Topo-4DGS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art 4DGS approaches across topological changes, especially on post-event frames. Code and data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 针对单目自我中心视频中切割、装配、开合等拓扑变化会使现有 4D Gaussian Splatting（4DGS）因形变固定表示而产生严重伪影的问题，作者提出 TopoEgo 基准与 Topo-4DGS：对交互部件施加独立刚体变换，并动态激活/停用高斯以表达表面的出现、消失或分离。作者称其在拓扑变化尤其是事件后帧上显著优于 SOTA 4DGS，但摘要未报告数值结果。
AI.motivation: 现有 4DGS 方法依赖对固定表示进行形变来重建动态场景，遇到切割、装配、打开、关闭等会分裂、合并或显现表面的日常交互时会产生严重视觉伪影；同时缺少专门针对自我中心视频拓扑变化的基准。
AI.method: 输入是单目自我中心视频，目标是重建发生拓扑变化的动态场景与物体。Topo-4DGS 联合建模部件级运动与随时间变化的表面支撑：为相互作用的部件分配独立刚体变换，并根据表面出现、消失或分离动态激活或停用高斯。相对“对固定表示做形变”的基线，改变在于显式允许表示发生拓扑增删与分离。产出为拓扑感知的 4D 高斯重建。作者另提出 TopoEgo 基准，覆盖 fission、fusion、open、close 四类变化。摘要未报告网络结构、训练细节或高斯数量等实现信息。
AI.result: 作者声称 Topo-4DGS 在拓扑变化上显著优于 state-of-the-art 4DGS 方法，尤其在事件后的帧上；摘要没有报告任务指标、数值、单位、具体基线名称、数据集规模或统计条件。TopoEgo 被作者称为首个面向自我中心视频拓扑变化的基准。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与世界模型研究而言，该工作把部件刚体运动与表面支撑的动态增删显式纳入 4D 高斯重建，方向上有助于缓解自我中心日常交互中的拓扑伪影；但摘要只提供定性的 SOTA 声明，缺少定量结果、真实机器人闭环或下游具身任务验证，无法判断精度与效率提升幅度及部署可行性。TopoEgo 若公开，可能为拓扑变化提供评测数据基础，但摘要未报告其规模与统计信息。
AI.core_method: 用部件级独立刚体运动加表面支撑的动态增删高斯，替代对固定 4D 表示的单纯形变。

key_results.finding: 作者称 Topo-4DGS 在拓扑变化上显著优于 SOTA 4DGS，尤其是事件后的帧；摘要未报告任何数值、指标、单位或具体基线名称。
key_results.setting: 任务：单目自我中心视频中的动态场景与物体重建；基准：TopoEgo，覆盖 fission、fusion、open、close；对比对象：state-of-the-art 4DGS 方法；具体指标与数值：摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Extensive experiments demonstrate that Topo-4DGS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art 4DGS approaches across topological changes, especially on post-event frames.

limitations: 作者报告的问题背景限制：现有 4DGS 依赖形变固定表示，在分裂、合并或表面显现等事件中会产生严重视觉伪影；这是对现有方法的描述，不是对 Topo-4DGS 失败案例的报告。
摘要未报告：任何定量结果、评价指标、单位、统计显著性、具体基线名称与实验条件，因此“显著优于”无法独立核验。
摘要未报告：真实机器人或具身下游任务评测、运行效率/延迟/显存等部署指标，以及 TopoEgo 的数据规模与统计；代码与数据仅称“将公开”。

6bd6bdf6a88d90084e31356b9b4dc369e761d446.title: Imitating the Imperfect: Offline-to-Online Robust Imitation Learning from Heterogeneous Demonstrators
6bd6bdf6a88d90084e31356b9b4dc369e761d446.summary: Imitation learning (IL) typically relies on large-scale offline demonstrations collected from multiple human or algorithmic demonstrators. However, most existing approaches assume these demonstrators are homogeneous or near-optimal experts, a convenient but unrealistic assumption in real-world applications. In practice, demonstrations are often collected from heterogeneous demonstrators with unknown and varying levels of expertise, resulting in highly mixed-quality data. In this work, we study a challenging yet practical setting of imitation learning from such heterogeneous imperfect demonstrators. We propose Latent Expertise and Optimality Scoring based Imitation Learning (LEOS-IL), a principled framework that jointly learns (i) a state-action optimality scoring model and (ii) latent expertise levels for each demonstrator from unlabeled suboptimal offline demonstrations. The learned scoring model is then integrated into an online policy optimization procedure, where the agent is trained to maximize estimated optimality scores while its online rollouts are iteratively leveraged to refine the scoring model, thereby mitigating distributional shift during online adaptation. We further provide theoretical guarantees for optimality score identification and conditional optimal occupancy and policy recovery under explicit sufficient conditions. Experiments on continuous control benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing baselines across highly heterogeneous and low-quality demonstration regimes.

AI.tldr: 现有模仿学习大多假设演示者同质或接近最优，而现实数据来自专业水平未知且不一的异质演示者。作者提出 LEOS-IL，从无标注的次优离线演示中联合学习最优性评分与各演示者的潜在专业水平，并将其接入在线策略优化。摘要称在连续控制基准上、特别是在高度异质与低质量演示场景中持续优于已有基线，但未给出任何数值。

298b3d2cbbd5961605a6229227861e334d3ee4dd.title: Robots That Talk Too Much and Don't Listen Enough
298b3d2cbbd5961605a6229227861e334d3ee4dd.comment: 4 pages, 3 figures, presented at EMF Workshop, HRI 2026, Edinburgh, Scotland
298b3d2cbbd5961605a6229227861e334d3ee4dd.summary: Until recently, the biggest obstacles to natural spoken interaction with social robots were speech recognition errors and turn-taking failures. Advances in speech recognition have enabled much better spoken interaction, but turn-taking failures and other misunderstandings continue to be far too prevalent. This short paper looks back at earlier methods for improving speech recognition and turn-taking in interaction with social robots, and then looks at what can be done today, arguing that multimodal bidirectional streaming is needed to reduce the frequency of turn-taking failures.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇短篇回顾/立场文章：梳理社交机器人语音识别与轮次管理（turn-taking）的早期改进方法，主张今天需要多模态双向流式处理来降低轮次失败频率；摘要未报告任何量化结果。
AI.motivation: 作者指出，过去自然口语交互的最大障碍是语音识别错误和轮次失败；语音识别的进步已显著改善口语交互，但轮次失败与其他误解仍然“远远过于普遍”，因此需要新的解决路径。
AI.method: 输入是与社交机器人进行的自然口语交互（含多模态信息）。做法上不是提出单一新模型，而是回顾早期提升语音识别与轮次处理的既有方法，再讨论当前可行手段，并据此给出方向性主张：应采用多模态双向流式处理，而不是把识别与轮次判断分开处理。产出是一个研究主张/建议——借此降低轮次失败的发生频率。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何数值结果、基准、指标或对比基线。仅有定性陈述：语音识别进展带来了更好的口语交互，但轮次失败和其他误解仍过于普遍，作者因此主张多模态双向流式处理。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型读者的意义在于：人机口语交互的瓶颈已从识别精度部分转移到交互时序（何时说、何时听）与误解处理，作者认为多模态双向流式是缓解方向。证据仅为短文的论证与回顾，摘要未提供实验验证，因此不能据此判断该主张已被实测支持。
AI.core_method: 以回顾与论证的方式提出立场：用多模态双向流式处理取代“先识别、再判轮次”的分离式流程，以减少社交机器人对话中的轮次失败。
limitations: 作者自述的问题状态（非方法局限）：语音识别已明显改善，但轮次失败与其他误解仍然过于普遍。
摘要未报告：任何数据集、任务设置、评价指标、数值结果、基线对比或消融实验。
摘要未报告：多模态双向流式处理的具体实现、系统架构、硬件平台或真实机器人部署情况。

3f7d0fc0dcee72ee35b81cfb1b1c0d97a0c4c8ac.title: Robust Task-Aware State Estimation from Pre-trained Perception
3f7d0fc0dcee72ee35b81cfb1b1c0d97a0c4c8ac.comment: The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), 2026
3f7d0fc0dcee72ee35b81cfb1b1c0d97a0c4c8ac.summary: Agents that perform state estimation using pretrained perception models, e.g., Vision-Language Models (VLMs), face the fundamental challenge that predictions are uncertain. Still, most approaches determinize these predictions into a single best-guess state and make decisions as if it were ground truth. This is brittle because when the guess is wrong, the agent's decisions may be unsafe or infeasible. At the other extreme, maintaining a full probability distribution over symbolic states is often intractable. We propose a middle path, drawing on the underlying probabilities the perception model already produces (e.g., a VLM's output-layer token distributions) to construct a $\theta$-confidence Minimal Belief Set (MBS$_\theta$), a minimal subset of states whose cumulative probability meets a user-specified belief-mass threshold. The minimality of an MBS$_\theta$ ensures that the agent considers only the most likely states, enhancing robustness in downstream decision-making while maintaining computational tractability. Using a novel three-layered belief system, we efficiently approximate individual state probabilities from per-feature predictions and task-level constraints. On this belief construction, we base our MBS$_\theta$ construction, while maintaining only a lean factored representation of the belief. Our algorithm, Probability-Ranked Valid State Search (PRaVaSS), takes advantage of the unique structure of this belief system to construct an MBS$_\theta$ with correctness guarantees and polynomial complexity in the unconstrained case. Using a VLM as the backbone of our state estimator, we validate our method's theoretical properties, scalability with problem size, and improvement of downstream decision-making when used in a task-planning pipeline.

AI.tldr: 针对用预训练VLM做状态估计时"把不确定预测确定化成单一最佳猜测"会导致决策脆弱、而维护完整符号状态分布又常不可解的问题，作者提出MBS_θ：累积概率达到用户给定信念质量阈值的最小状态子集，并给出构造算法PRaVaSS。摘要称以VLM为状态估计骨干验证了理论性质、随问题规模的可扩展性与任务规划管线中下游决策的改善，但未报告任何数值结果。
AI.motivation: 预训练感知模型（如VLM）的状态预测本身不确定，但多数做法把它确定化为单一"最佳猜测"并当作真值来决策；一旦猜错，决策可能不安全或不可行。另一极端是维护符号状态上的完整概率分布，通常不可解。
AI.method: 输入是用户指定的信念质量阈值θ、感知模型（VLM）已有的概率输出（如输出层token分布）以及任务级约束。方法不取唯一最佳猜测、也不枚举完整分布：先用一个三层信念系统从逐特征预测与任务约束近似每个状态的概率，并只保留精简的因子化信念表示；再在该结构上定义MBS_θ——累积概率达到θ的最小状态子集，由PRaVaSS利用该结构搜索构造，作者称在无约束情形下具备正确性保证与多项式复杂度。输出是供下游任务规划/决策使用的最小高概率状态集合。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何数值结果：没有任务/基准名称、指标值、单位、基线或实验条件。作者仅声称以VLM作为状态估计骨干，验证了方法的理论性质、随问题规模的可扩展性，以及在任务规划管线中使用时下游决策得到改善；并声称PRaVaSS在无约束情形下可构造具有正确性保证、复杂度为多项式的MBS_θ，但未给出复杂度阶数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提示一条中间路线：保留感知模型原生概率，但只显式携带"够用"的最小高概率状态子集，从而在可解性与决策鲁棒性之间折中，对依赖VLM做状态估计的具身智能体有参考价值。但证据仅限摘要：无定量结果，未说明仿真还是真机，也未与单点估计或完整分布方法做量化对比，鲁棒性提升幅度与实际计算开销仍待全文验证。
AI.core_method: 用感知模型自带的逐特征概率加任务约束构建三层信念系统，只保留累积概率达到阈值θ的最小状态子集作为信念集。

key_results.finding: 作者称以VLM作为状态估计器时，在任务规划管线中使用该方法可改善下游决策；摘要未给出任何指标、数值、单位或基线。
key_results.setting: 状态估计骨干为VLM，下游为任务规划管线；具体基准、平台（仿真或真机）与实验条件摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Using a VLM as the backbone of our state estimator, we validate our method's theoretical properties, scalability with problem size, and improvement of downstream decision-making when used in a task-planning pipeline.

key_results.finding: 作者声称PRaVaSS在无约束情形下可构造具正确性保证、复杂度为多项式的MBS_θ；摘要未给出复杂度阶数或证明细节。
key_results.setting: 无约束（unconstrained）情形；问题规模、状态空间大小等条件摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Our algorithm, Probability-Ranked Valid State Search (PRaVaSS), takes advantage of the unique structure of this belief system to construct an MBS$_\theta$ with correctness guarantees and polynomial complexity in the unconstrained case.

limitations: 摘要未报告任何定量结果，也未说明实验是仿真还是真机、使用何种基准或基线（not reported in the abstract）。
摘要未报告阈值θ的取值、MBS_θ规模与计算开销的实测数据，也未报告失败案例或安全/可行性指标（not reported in the abstract）。
作者未在摘要中陈述该方法的自身局限；仅在动机中把'确定化为单一预测'与'维护完整分布'列为既有做法的两端问题，这属于对现有方法的批评而非作者报告的本方法缺陷（not reported in the abstract）。

55e025efc500e402bdc53c5c92916711bf61839f.title: SunLightBots: Turning sunlight into self-sustained, high-power motion in soft robots
55e025efc500e402bdc53c5c92916711bf61839f.summary: Soft robots built from active materials can directly convert environmental stimuli into motion, offering a route to energy autonomy and embodied control. However, environmental energy is generally harvested at low power, whereas rapid, mechanically demanding actions require high mechanical output power. Reconciling this mismatch while sustaining self-regulated cyclic actuation is challenging, particularly at the subgram scale, where limited payload capacity constrains the integration of conventional power and control hardware. Here, we present SunLightBots, a class of subgram, sunlight-powered, untethered soft robots that achieve autonomous locomotion under continuous illumination near 1 Sun (100 mW/cm2). Their operation is enabled by a self-resetting snapping (SRS) mechanism that integrates liquid crystal elastomers (LCEs) with snap-through instability to accumulate solar energy supplied at low power, release it as rapid, high-power motion, and reset through photothermal-mechanical feedback. Through coordinated optimization of the LCE actuation temperature, photothermal conversion, actuation stress, and structural energy barrier, the system operates near 1 Sun and achieves a peak mass-specific mechanical power of 89 W/kg. At this irradiance, the optimized LCE generates an actuation stress of 0.1 MPa at approximately 60 deg C. SunLightBots demonstrate sustained swimming, crawling, and repeated impulsive jumping. Under 1.5 Suns, the swimmer advances more than three body lengths per cycle. This work provides a materials-mechanics route toward autonomous soft robots powered entirely by the environment.

AI.tldr: SunLightBots 用自复位突弹（SRS）机制把低功率太阳能在亚克级软体机器人内累积后以高功率瞬时释放，在近 1 Sun 连续光照下实现自主无缆运动，峰值质量比机械功率 89 W/kg。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出核心矛盾：环境能量通常只能以低功率被收集，而快速、机械负荷大的动作需要高机械输出功率；在亚克（subgram）尺度上，载荷能力有限又限制了常规电源与控制硬件的集成，因此既要弥合这一功率错配，又要维持自调节的循环驱动。
AI.method: 输入是连续光照（近 1 Sun，100 mW/cm2）这一环境能源。方法将液晶弹性体（LCE）与突弹失稳（snap-through instability）结合，构成自复位突弹（SRS）机制：先在低功率下累积太阳能，再以快速、高功率的形式释放，并通过光热—机械反馈完成复位。摘要还提到对 LCE 驱动温度、光热转换、驱动应力和结构能垒进行协同优化。输出是亚克级、无缆、可在光照下自主运动的软体机器人（游泳、爬行、重复脉冲跳跃）。摘要未报告相对基线的改动细节。
AI.result: 作者报告：优化后系统在近 1 Sun 工作，峰值质量比机械功率为 89 W/kg；该辐照度下优化 LCE 在约 60 deg C 产生 0.1 MPa 驱动应力；1.5 Suns 下游泳体每周期前进超过三个体长。摘要未报告基线对比、效率、寿命或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：把能量收集、储能与释放机制嵌入材料—结构本身，使亚克级软体机器人无需板载电源与控制硬件即可产生自调节循环运动，为"能量自主＋具身控制"提供了一条材料—力学路径。证据边界：摘要仅给出功率、应力与位移类指标，未提供与既有方法的定量比较、真实环境长期运行数据或感知/决策能力，因此不能推断其具备感知、规划或通用任务能力。
AI.core_method: 将液晶弹性体驱动与突弹失稳耦合，用光热—机械反馈实现"低功率累积太阳能—高功率瞬时释放—自动复位"的循环驱动。

key_results.finding: 系统在近 1 Sun 光照下工作，峰值质量比机械功率达 89 W/kg。
key_results.setting: 亚克级、无缆软体机器人，连续光照近 1 Sun（100 mW/cm2）；基线对比、样本量与统计信息摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: the system operates near 1 Sun and achieves a peak mass-specific mechanical power of 89 W/kg

key_results.finding: 在该辐照度下，优化后的 LCE 在约 60 deg C 时产生 0.1 MPa 的驱动应力。
key_results.setting: 近 1 Sun 光照条件下的材料级测量；测量方法与重复次数摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: At this irradiance, the optimized LCE generates an actuation stress of 0.1 MPa at approximately 60 deg C.

key_results.finding: 在 1.5 Suns 光照下，游泳型机器人每个周期前进超过三个体长。
key_results.setting: 游泳任务，光照强度 1.5 Suns；摘要未报告具体速度单位、周期时长或对照条件。
key_results.evidence_quote: Under 1.5 Suns, the swimmer advances more than three body lengths per cycle.

limitations: 作者在摘要中明确指出的约束：亚克尺度下载荷能力有限，难以集成常规电源与控制硬件；环境能量通常以低功率被收集，与高机械输出功率需求存在错配。
摘要未报告与现有软体机器人或驱动方案的定量基线对比，也未报告能量转换效率、循环寿命/耐久性与失效条件。
