28eae5c368586846d3ce7872093481a25a4b0bee.title: Escaping Latent Traps by Remembering: Training-Free Episodic Kernel Repulsion for World-Model Planning
28eae5c368586846d3ce7872093481a25a4b0bee.summary: Latent world models plan towards a goal image by minimising the distance between predicted and goal latents. This distance is not geodesic: it has local minima, latent traps, behind walls, at corners and in dead ends, and memoryless receding-horizon replanning keeps the agent in them, revisiting states far from the goal. We propose Episodic Kernel Repulsion (EKR), a training-free cost term that penalises candidate plans by a top-$k$ Gaussian kernel to a novelty-gated memory of the latents the agent has actually visited, rescaled by the current base cost so that its strength is comparable across models. Across two JEPA world models and four benchmarks, EKR raises average success from 31.8% to 46.7% (LeWM) and from 54.7% to 64.0% (H-JEPA) with the same model, planner and budget. Same-memory counterfactuals show that, in most settings, EKR pushes plans away from visited states, in navigation, often at a higher base cost; stuck episodes and revisits drop accordingly. In seven of eight settings it matches or exceeds $4\times$ samples at $0.8$--$1.5\times$ compute. Without tuning, it transfers to DINO-WM with CEM: $+6.7$ and $+19.3$ points on official and longer-goal Wall tasks, and from 44.7% to 100.0% and from 21.0% to 32.0% on long-horizon PointMaze and Push-T.

AI.tldr: 针对潜空间世界模型中预测潜变量与目标图像的距离存在局部极小值（latent traps）的问题，EKR 在不训练模型的前提下，用已访问潜变量记忆构造 top-k 高斯核排斥代价项来修正规划代价。作者报告在两个 JEPA 世界模型和四个基准上平均成功率从 31.8% 升至 46.7%（LeWM）、从 54.7% 升至 64.0%（H-JEPA），并在 DINO-WM+CEM 上无需调参迁移。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，潜空间世界模型通过最小化预测潜变量与目标潜变量的距离来规划，但该距离不是测地距离，存在墙后、拐角、死胡同等局部极小值（latent traps）；无记忆的滚动时域重规划会让智能体困在其中并反复访问远离目标的状态。
AI.method: 输入是候选规划、世界模型预测的潜变量、目标潜变量，以及智能体实际访问过的潜变量记忆。方法不更新模型参数，而是在原规划代价上增加一个训练无关的代价项：用 top-k 高斯核度量候选计划与 novelty-gated 访问记忆的接近程度，并按其当前 base cost 缩放，使其在不同模型间强度可比。输出是修正后的规划代价，用于选出更少回到已访问状态的候选计划。相对基线变化是：在原本仅最小化预测—目标潜变量距离、无记忆重规划的基础上加入 episodic memory 排斥项。
AI.result: 作者报告：在两个 JEPA 世界模型和四个基准上，相同模型、规划器和预算下，EKR 将平均成功率从 31.8% 提高到 46.7%（LeWM），从 54.7% 提高到 64.0%（H-JEPA）。同记忆反事实显示，多数设置中 EKR 把规划推离已访问状态，导航中常以更高 base cost 为代价，stuck episodes 与 revisits 相应下降。在八个设置中的七个，它以 0.8–1.5× 计算量达到或超过 4× 采样的表现。无需调参迁移到 DINO-WM+CEM：官方与 longer-goal Wall 任务分别 +6.7 和 +19.3 个百分点，long-horizon PointMaze 从 44.7% 到 100.0%，Push-T 从 21.0% 到 32.0%。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型规划而言，这提示：仅用潜空间距离做目标条件规划会受非测地局部极小值影响，而显式情节记忆可作为训练无关的规划修正。证据边界是作者报告的多基准结果与迁移结果；摘要未提供真实机器人验证、统计显著性或完整消融，因此不能据此推断真实部署效果或普适性。
AI.core_method: 在原有潜空间距离规划代价上，加一个由实际访问记忆和 top-k 高斯核构成的训练无关排斥项，把候选计划推离已访问的潜变量状态。

key_results.finding: 在两个 JEPA 世界模型、四个基准上，相同模型、规划器与预算下，平均成功率从 31.8% 提升到 46.7%（LeWM），从 54.7% 提升到 64.0%（H-JEPA）。
key_results.setting: 任务：潜空间世界模型规划；模型：LeWM、H-JEPA 两个 JEPA 世界模型；基准：四个基准（摘要未列名）；对照：同一模型、规划器和预算下不加 EKR；指标：平均成功率（%）。
key_results.evidence_quote: Across two JEPA world models and four benchmarks, EKR raises average success from 31.8% to 46.7% (LeWM) and from 54.7% to 64.0% (H-JEPA) with the same model, planner and budget.

key_results.finding: 在八个设置中的七个，EKR 以 0.8–1.5× 计算量达到或超过 4× 采样的表现。
key_results.setting: 任务：八个设置（摘要未列名）；对照：4× 采样；指标：计算量倍数与表现匹配/超过关系；摘要未报告具体任务、模型或显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: In seven of eight settings it matches or exceeds $4\times$ samples at $0.8$--$1.5\times$ compute.

key_results.finding: 无需调参迁移到 DINO-WM+CEM：官方与 longer-goal Wall 任务分别提升 +6.7 和 +19.3 个百分点；long-horizon PointMaze 从 44.7% 到 100.0%，Push-T 从 21.0% 到 32.0%。
key_results.setting: 任务：DINO-WM 世界模型配合 CEM 规划器，无需调参；场景：官方 Wall、longer-goal Wall、long-horizon PointMaze、Push-T；对照：未使用 EKR 的对应基线；指标：成功率/百分点提升。
key_results.evidence_quote: Without tuning, it transfers to DINO-WM with CEM: $+6.7$ and $+19.3$ points on official and longer-goal Wall tasks, and from 44.7% to 100.0% and from 21.0% to 32.0% on long-horizon PointMaze and Push-T.

limitations: 作者报告在导航中 EKR 常以更高的 base cost 将规划推离已访问状态，说明该方法并非零代价；摘要未给出该代价的量化上限或适用边界。
摘要未报告真实机器人实验；所报告结果来自基准测试与 DINO-WM+CEM 迁移，不能据此推断真实世界部署。
摘要未报告 top-k、核带宽、novelty gate、记忆规模等超参数设置，也未报告统计显著性、样本量或失败案例。

9ee408009d5a1860a173db9c142c910e3ce91542.title: Distilling World Action Models for Efficient Bimanual Manipulation via Anchored Path Matching
9ee408009d5a1860a173db9c142c910e3ce91542.summary: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative denoising. Few-step distillation reduces the number of model evaluations, but its coarse updates can move the student away from the teacher's trajectory. We propose Anchored Path Matching (APM), which supervises endpoint and short-transition predictions from states reached by the student. From each state, we continue the teacher to zero noise and use its endpoint and first intermediate state as targets. Modality-routed adapters learn to match both targets from the same starting state. When the two gradients conflict, anchor-priority updates preserve the endpoint gradient and remove the opposing component of the local gradient within each modality. One checkpoint supports 1-, 2-, and 4-step joint generation. The sampling budget can be chosen at deployment without retraining or teacher queries. On RoboTwin 2.0, we train only on Clean demonstrations and evaluate directly on the domain-randomized Random setting. At one step, APM improves closed-loop success over continued base distillation at matched inference budgets by 2.0 percentage points on Clean and 1.4 on Random. Video peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) rises from 30.169 to 32.317 dB, with gains in structural similarity (SSIM) and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS). On two real-robot tasks, APM improves success over the one-step teacher and reduces control-cycle latency by $21.3\times$ relative to the eight-step this http URL page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 针对世界动作模型(WAM)少步蒸馏时粗糙更新会使学生模型偏离教师轨迹的问题，作者提出 Anchored Path Matching (APM)，用学生到达状态下的教师端点与首个中间状态作锚点监督。单检查点支持 1/2/4 步生成，在 RoboTwin 2.0 上 1 步闭环保真率较基线蒸馏提升 2.0（Clean）与 1.4（Random）个百分点。
AI.motivation: WAM 通过迭代去噪联合生成未来视频与机器人动作，推理时模型评估次数多。少步蒸馏可减少评估次数，但其粗糙更新会把学生推离教师轨迹。摘要指出这一偏离是本文要解决的缺口。
AI.method: 输入是 WAM 的教师模型与学生模型，以及学生自身采样所到达的状态。方法不直接回归教师的最终输出，而是从学生到达的每个状态出发，继续运行教师至零噪声，取其端点（最终去噪结果）与第一个中间状态作为监督目标；再由模态路由适配器(modality-routed adapters)在同一初始状态下同时匹配这两个目标。当两个目标的梯度冲突时，anchor-priority 更新保留端点梯度，并在每种模态内去掉局部梯度中与其相反的分量。产物是一个检查点，可在部署时选择 1、2 或 4 步采样预算，无需重训练或查询教师。相对基线（continued base distillation）的改动在于监督目标与梯度冲突处理方式。
AI.result: RoboTwin 2.0 上仅在 Clean 演示上训练、直接在域随机化的 Random 设置上评估：1 步时闭环保真率较 continued base distillation 在匹配推理预算下提升 Clean 2.0 个百分点、Random 1.4 个百分点。视频 PSNR 由 30.169 dB 升至 32.317 dB，SSIM 与 LPIPS 亦有提升。两个真机任务上保真率优于一步教师，控制周期延迟相对八步教师降低 21.3×。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明：把蒸馏监督锚定在学生实际到达的状态上、并显式处理端点与局部转移的梯度冲突，可在保持 WAM 联合视频—动作生成质量的同时显著压缩去噪步数，且一个检查点即可覆盖多种步数预算。对具身智能的意义在于推理成本与部署灵活性；但证据边界是：摘要未报告绝对保真率、真机试验次数、延迟绝对值与统计显著性，视频指标提升也未说明是否与保真率提升同源。
AI.core_method: 从学生实际到达的状态出发，让教师继续去噪到零噪声，用其端点与首个中间状态同时监督模态路由适配器，冲突时优先保留端点梯度。

key_results.finding: 视频 PSNR 从 30.169 dB 提升到 32.317 dB，SSIM 与 LPIPS 也有增益（作者报告，未给出 SSIM/LPIPS 数值）
key_results.setting: RoboTwin 2.0 生成视频质量评估；对照基线为 continued base distillation（摘要以“rises from … to …”表述，未逐一说明比较对象与条件）
key_results.evidence_quote: Video peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) rises from 30.169 to 32.317 dB, with gains in structural similarity (SSIM) and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS).

key_results.finding: 两个真机任务上保真率优于一步教师，控制周期延迟相对八步教师降低 21.3×
key_results.setting: 两个真机任务；对照为一步教师（保真率）与八步教师（延迟）；未报告绝对保真率、延迟数值与试验次数
key_results.evidence_quote: On two real-robot tasks, APM improves success over the one-step teacher and reduces control-cycle latency by $21.3\times$ relative to the eight-step this http URL page: this https URL .

limitations: 摘要未报告绝对保真率数值，只给出相对 continued base distillation 的百分点提升，因此无法判断任务的绝对难度与提升的实际幅度。
摘要未报告真机任务的试验次数、任务具体内容、延迟绝对值与统计显著性；21.3× 仅为相对八步教师的加速倍数。
部分结果未附可定位的摘要原句，或数字未出现在所附依据中，未作为关键结果展示。

5b9dafb17123eb0831518c972c06076425f4c7c6.title: Plausible Videos Can Lead to Poor Decisions: Diagnosing and CURE-ing World Models for Planning
5b9dafb17123eb0831518c972c06076425f4c7c6.summary: Action-conditioned world models are increasingly used as world models for planning, yet a world model that makes plausible, realistic-looking videos that are consistent with the training data can produce poor decisions. We address two key questions: (1) when can we trust a world model for planning, and (2) what should we do when we cannot? We introduce CURE (Certify, Upweight, Rollout, Explore), a certificate-guided technique that assesses whether a world model can be trusted for planning and determines what to do next: whether to upweight the training data to debias the model; roll out more samples at test time; or explore by collecting new data where support (how well the training data cover the planner's decisions) is missing. We deploy CURE across multiple domains, spanning simulated physics based on PhyWorld, MuJoCo arm control, and Language-Table pushing in simulation and on real videos. The decisions our certificate trusts have lower regret than those it does not (e.g., 0.06 vs. 0.38 on Language-Table sim and 0.07 vs. 0.38 on MuJoCo contact), whereas video perceptual quality does not identify good decisions. By focusing on decision quality rather than perceptual quality, CURE lowers regret over the best pessimistic decision rule by 10-25% across support levels, and over world-action models, search and policy learning by 41-64%, given the same data.

AI.tldr: 动作条件世界模型能生成逼真视频，却可能给出糟糕的规划决策；CURE 用"证书"判断世界模型何时可被信任，并据此决定加权训练数据、增加测试时采样或采集新数据。作者报告：被证书信任的决策遗憾更低（Language-Table 仿真 0.06 vs. 0.38；MuJoCo 接触 0.07 vs. 0.38），而视频感知质量无法识别好决策。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，动作条件世界模型正越来越多地被用于规划，但一个能生成与训练数据一致、看起来合理逼真的视频的世界模型，仍可能产生很差的决策。作者据此提出两个问题：何时可以信任世界模型用于规划，以及在不能信任时应该做什么。摘要未报告更细的失败成因分析。
AI.method: 输入是动作条件世界模型、其训练数据与规划器；CURE（Certify、Upweight、Rollout、Explore）先给出证书，判断该世界模型在当前规划器决策上是否可信，核心依据是"支撑度"——训练数据对规划器决策的覆盖程度。输出是一个后续动作选择：当偏差可纠正时对训练数据加权以去偏模型；当不确定性靠采样可缓解时在测试时展开更多样本；当支撑度缺失时，去采集新数据（探索）。相对被比较的基线（悲观决策规则、world-action 模型、搜索与策略学习），变化在于把判据从视频感知质量换成决策质量。
AI.result: 作者在基于 PhyWorld 的仿真物理、MuJoCo 机械臂控制、以及仿真与真实视频上的 Language-Table 推物任务中部署 CURE。报告称证书信任的决策比不信任的决策遗憾更低（Language-Table 仿真 0.06 vs. 0.38；MuJoCo 接触 0.07 vs. 0.38），而视频感知质量不能识别好决策。相对最佳悲观决策规则，CURE 在不同支撑度水平上把遗憾降低 10-25%；在相同数据下，相对 world-action 模型、搜索与策略学习降低 41-64%。这些均为相对百分比表述，摘要未给出统计显著性、样本量或方差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把世界模型用于规划的评判标准从"视频看起来是否合理"转向"决策是否可被证书信任"，并给出不可信时的三种补救路径，对世界模型与规划结合的研究方向有直接意义。证据边界：结果来自仿真物理、MuJoCo 与 Language-Table（仿真及真实视频），摘要未报告真实机器人闭环部署的定量结果，也未报告各补救分支的消融与显著性检验，因此"证书指导优于基线"目前仅为作者报告，未经独立验证。
AI.core_method: 用一个基于训练数据对规划器决策"支撑度"的证书来判断世界模型是否可信，并据此选择数据加权、测试时多样本展开或采集新数据。

key_results.finding: 证书信任的决策遗憾低于不被信任的决策（Language-Table 仿真 0.06 vs. 0.38；MuJoCo 接触 0.07 vs. 0.38），而视频感知质量无法区分好决策。
key_results.setting: 任务：Language-Table 推物（仿真）与 MuJoCo 接触任务；指标：遗憾（regret）；比较对象：证书信任 vs. 不信任的决策，以及视频感知质量作为对照判据。摘要未报告样本量与显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: The decisions our certificate trusts have lower regret than those it does not (e.g., 0.06 vs. 0.38 on Language-Table sim and 0.07 vs. 0.38 on MuJoCo contact), whereas video perceptual quality does not identify good decisions.

key_results.finding: 相对最佳悲观决策规则，CURE 在不同支撑度水平上把遗憾降低 10-25%（相对百分比）。
key_results.setting: 任务：跨多个域（PhyWorld 仿真物理、MuJoCo 机械臂控制、Language-Table 仿真与真实视频）的规划；指标：遗憾；基线：最佳悲观决策规则；条件：不同支撑度水平。摘要未报告具体数值表与显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: CURE lowers regret over the best pessimistic decision rule by 10-25% across support levels

key_results.finding: 在相同数据条件下，相对 world-action 模型、搜索与策略学习，CURE 把遗憾降低 41-64%（相对百分比）。
key_results.setting: 任务：同一批跨域规划实验；指标：遗憾；基线：world-action 模型、搜索、策略学习；条件：given the same data（相同数据）。摘要未报告样本量与显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: over world-action models, search and policy learning by 41-64%, given the same data.

limitations: 作者未在摘要中报告统计显著性、样本量、随机种子数或误差范围，因此上述 10-25% 与 41-64% 的降幅仅为点估计式表述。
摘要提到在真实视频上评估 Language-Table，但未报告真实机器人闭环部署的定量结果，不能由摘要推断实机可用性。
摘要未报告 CURE 三个分支（Upweight、Rollout、Explore）各自的消融贡献，也未报告证书本身的校准或误判率；以上为摘要未报告项，而非作者承认的缺陷。

b573c47c127081cfd5085d62e953b8a204f2c803.title: SpikWM: Efficient End-to-End Spiking World Modeling for Visual Planning
b573c47c127081cfd5085d62e953b8a204f2c803.summary: Goal-conditioned planning with image observations and goals requires predictions that distinguish visual states and action consequences. Spiking neural networks offer sparse computation, but single-step spikes can obscure motion cues and merge actions with different physical outcomes. We propose the Spiking Latent World Model (SpikWM), an end-to-end joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) with one simulation step per image and one neural update per latent position. Spiking Regional Encoding retains spatial cues through regional pooling. Bi-Spike Action Encoding combines positive and negative binary responses, while Causal Membrane Prediction carries subthreshold evidence across the latent history with learned group-wise time constants. The encoder and predictor are trained jointly on reward-free image--action trajectories using next-embedding prediction and SIGReg. With a common planner, SpikWM achieves mean success rates of $88.67\%$, $97.33\%$, $99.33\%$, and $86.67\%$ on Push-T, Two-Room, Reacher, and OGBench-Cube, respectively, outperforming two spiking baselines. Push-T ablations support each module, and controlled replays examine responses to appearance and physical state changes. Under a matched planning budget, SpikWM reduces estimated arithmetic energy by $75.6\%$ relative to LeWM. Code will be released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SpikWM 是面向视觉目标条件规划的端到端脉冲潜世界模型（JEPA），每张图像一步仿真、每个潜位置一次神经更新。摘要报告在 Push-T、Two-Room、Reacher、OGBench-Cube 上平均成功率为 88.67%、97.33%、99.33%、86.67%，优于两个脉冲基线；在匹配规划预算下，估计算术能耗较 LeWM 降低 75.6%。
AI.motivation: 目标条件规划需要预测能区分视觉状态与动作后果。脉冲神经网络计算稀疏，但摘要指出单步脉冲会模糊运动线索，并把物理后果不同的动作混在一起。
AI.method: 输入是奖励无关的图像—动作轨迹（图像观测与目标）。编码器把图像编码为脉冲潜表示，预测器每个潜位置只做一次神经更新、每张图像只做一步仿真。三个机制：Spiking Regional Encoding 用区域池化保留空间线索；Bi-Spike Action Encoding 用正负二值响应表示动作；Causal Membrane Prediction 用可学习的组级时间常数把阈下证据沿潜历史传递。编码器与预测器在下一嵌入预测与 SIGReg 目标下端到端联合训练，产出可供规划使用的潜世界模型；规划阶段使用一个公共规划器。相对所述脉冲基线的变化在于动作编码方式与跨潜历史膜电位的时间常数学习。
AI.result: 在使用同一规划器时，平均成功率为 Push-T 88.67%、Two-Room 97.33%、Reacher 99.33%、OGBench-Cube 86.67%，优于两个脉冲基线。匹配规划预算下，估计算术能耗相对 LeWM 降低 75.6%（相对降幅）。Push-T 消融支持各模块，受控回放考察了对外观与物理状态变化的响应（摘要未给出数值）。摘要未报告真机实验、绝对能耗、延迟或数据集规模。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型研究而言，该工作给出一种把稀疏脉冲计算与潜空间世界模型结合用于目标条件视觉规划的思路：动作的双脉冲编码与跨潜历史的膜电位时间常数被用来保留运动线索并区分动作后果。证据边界在于，摘要只报告四个基准的成功率、相对 LeWM 的估计能耗降幅以及定性消融，未报告真机部署、实测能耗与延迟，也未报告统计检验；所有结论均为作者报告，未经独立验证。
AI.core_method: 用区域池化脉冲编码、正负双脉冲动作编码和跨潜历史的因果膜电位预测，端到端联合训练编码器与预测器做下一嵌入预测。

key_results.finding: 在共用同一规划器的条件下，SpikWM 在四个基准上的平均成功率为 88.67%、97.33%、99.33%、86.67%，优于两个脉冲基线。
key_results.setting: 基准：Push-T、Two-Room、Reacher、OGBench-Cube；比较对象：两个脉冲基线；条件：同一规划器。摘要未报告真机实验、样本量与统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: With a common planner, SpikWM achieves mean success rates of $88.67\%$, $97.33\%$, $99.33\%$, and $86.67\%$ on Push-T, Two-Room, Reacher, and OGBench-Cube, respectively, outperforming two spiking baselines.

key_results.finding: 在匹配规划预算下，估计算术能耗相对 LeWM 降低 75.6%（相对百分比降幅，不是百分点）。
key_results.setting: 条件：匹配的规划预算；基线：LeWM；指标：估计算术能耗。摘要未报告绝对能耗数值与能耗测量方式。
key_results.evidence_quote: Under a matched planning budget, SpikWM reduces estimated arithmetic energy by $75.6\%$ relative to LeWM.

key_results.finding: Push-T 消融实验支持各模块的作用；受控回放考察模型对外观变化与物理状态变化的响应（摘要未给出任何数值）。
key_results.setting: 基准：Push-T 消融与受控回放实验。摘要未报告具体指标、数值与消融设置。
key_results.evidence_quote: Push-T ablations support each module, and controlled replays examine responses to appearance and physical state changes.

limitations: 摘要未报告真实机器人实验，全部结果来自 Push-T、Two-Room、Reacher、OGBench-Cube 基准，且摘要未说明这些结果是仿真还是真机。
能耗为“估计算术能耗”而非实测硬件能耗，且摘要未报告绝对值、延迟或吞吐。
摘要未报告消融的定量结果、数据集规模、训练成本与统计显著性。

b737dfe6b298bf0f8ca3ffb275e4378521c6c551.title: Seeing What Still Holds: How Waiting Control Changes Cooperative Recovery
b737dfe6b298bf0f8ca3ffb275e4378521c6c551.summary: Changing the holding reference during a fixed-duration wait can reverse the ranking of visual recovery methods. We introduce AuditEmbodied, a paired execution and trajectory evaluation framework that independently varies holding references and waiting duration while keeping recovery executors frozen. A 960-execution factorial on 20 initialization seeds compares CAD-feedback and landmark-based recovery from identical post-wait physical states within each holding and waiting condition. Protected completion requires successful recovery under the declared execution constraints. At a 1 s wait with registered wrist references, their protected completion counts change from 6/40 versus 19/40 under registered holding to 34/40 versus 22/40 under position-only holding. Trajectory analysis localizes the main separation to grasp formation: small observation-time target residuals precede large tracking errors. Joint diagnostics and controlled interventions characterize persistent tracking constraints. On fresh seeds, gradual position reanchoring improves CAD recovery's long-wait completion by 42.5 percentage points and reduces mean complete recovery time by 6.06 s relative to registered holding. Additional evaluations with pretrained policies, handover, and a mass-matched geometry characterize holding-reference sensitivity across executors and physical regimes. These findings establish holding reference as an explicit evaluation condition for comparing visual recovery performance.

AI.tldr: 固定时长等待中改变"保持参考"（holding reference）会反转视觉恢复方法的排名。作者提出 AuditEmbodied 配对执行与轨迹评测框架，在冻结恢复执行器的前提下独立改变保持参考与等待时长；在 1 s 等待下，CAD-feedback 与 landmark-based 恢复的受保护完成计数由 registered holding 下的 6/40 对 19/40 变为 position-only holding 下的 34/40 对 22/40。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，改变固定时长等待中的保持参考即可反转视觉恢复方法的排名，说明以往方法对比可能没有把保持参考当作显式的评测条件，从而使排序依赖于未声明的执行设定。
AI.method: 输入是同一等待后物理状态下、来自两种恢复执行器（CAD-feedback 与 landmark-based）的执行轨迹。AuditEmbodied 是一个配对执行与轨迹评测框架：它独立改变保持参考与等待时长，同时保持恢复执行器冻结，从而在同一保持/等待条件内做同源比较，并配套轨迹分析与干预诊断。规模为 20 个初始化种子的 960 次执行析因实验，输出为"受保护完成"计数（要求在执行约束下成功恢复）以及定位失败阶段的轨迹诊断。相对基线为 registered holding 与 position-only holding 两种参考设定，以及 gradual position reanchoring 与 registered holding 的对比。
AI.result: 作者报告在 1 s 等待、registered wrist references 条件下，两种方法的受保护完成计数随保持参考设定发生反转；轨迹分析把主要差异定位在抓取形成（grasp formation）阶段，即小的观测时刻目标残差先于大的跟踪误差出现；在新种子上，gradual position reanchoring 相对 registered holding 将 CAD 恢复的长等待完成率提高 42.5 个百分点，并把平均完整恢复时间缩短 6.06 s。另有使用预训练策略、handover 以及质量匹配几何的补充评测，用以刻画跨执行器与物理设定下的保持参考敏感性。摘要未报告数值基线以外的统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：比较视觉恢复或抓取恢复方法时，保持参考应当作为显式评测条件被声明与固定，否则同一执行器在不同保持参考下会得到相反的方法排序；同时恢复失败可被轨迹诊断定位到抓取形成阶段。证据边界：以上均为作者在摘要中报告的计数、百分点与时间差，未给出硬件平台、仿真或实机区分、统计显著性与完整方法细节。
AI.core_method: 在冻结恢复执行器的前提下，配对地独立改变保持参考与等待时长，从同一等待后物理状态比较不同恢复方法并做轨迹诊断。

key_results.finding: 在 1 s 等待、registered wrist references 下，两种恢复方法的受保护完成计数随保持参考反转：CAD-feedback 由 6/40 升至 34/40，landmark-based 由 19/40 降至 22/40。
key_results.setting: 20 个初始化种子的 960 次执行析因实验；两种恢复执行器从相同等待后物理状态出发；对比 registered holding 与 position-only holding；指标为受保护完成计数（分母 40）。
key_results.evidence_quote: At a 1 s wait with registered wrist references, their protected completion counts change from 6/40 versus 19/40 under registered holding to 34/40 versus 22/40 under position-only holding.

key_results.finding: 在新种子上，gradual position reanchoring 使 CAD 恢复的长等待完成率相对 registered holding 提高 42.5 个百分点，平均完整恢复时间减少 6.06 s。
key_results.setting: 新初始化种子；对比 gradual position reanchoring 与 registered holding；指标为长等待完成率（百分点）与平均完整恢复时间（s）。
key_results.evidence_quote: On fresh seeds, gradual position reanchoring improves CAD recovery's long-wait completion by 42.5 percentage points and reduces mean complete recovery time by 6.06 s relative to registered holding.

key_results.finding: 轨迹分析把两种方法的主要差异定位在抓取形成阶段：观测时刻的小目标残差先于大的跟踪误差出现。
key_results.setting: 配对执行与轨迹分析；具体轨迹指标与样本量摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Trajectory analysis localizes the main separation to grasp formation: small observation-time target residuals precede large tracking errors.

limitations: 摘要未报告实验是在仿真还是真实机器人上完成，也未给出硬件或执行器平台信息。
摘要未报告统计显著性、置信区间或重复次数以外的方差信息。
作者报告了补充评测（预训练策略、handover、质量匹配几何），但摘要未报告这些评测的具体数值结果；此外 'declared execution constraints' 的具体内容未在摘要中说明。

28ffa1a99c870ca14a44e1e464b7656ca4a1f4ef.title: CoBoVLA: Decoupling Language from Action with Discrete Codes for Robust and Interpretable Robot Manipulation
28ffa1a99c870ca14a44e1e464b7656ca4a1f4ef.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, and supplemental material included
28ffa1a99c870ca14a44e1e464b7656ca4a1f4ef.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve high success rates on the LIBERO benchmark but remain sensitive to paraphrasing. Existing VLAs ranging from 0.6B to 7.5B parameters experience a 22-52 point performance drop on LIBERO-Para while SmolVLA exhibits an even larger decline, from 83\% to 8\%. Because most VLAs jointly learn language understanding and action generation, it is difficult to determine whether a failure originates from misunderstanding an instruction or executing it incorrectly. To address these challenges, we introduce CoBoVLA, or CodeBookVLA, a 250M-parameter VLA that decouples language understanding, planning, and control through learned discrete interpretable codes. A text encoder maps the instructions to shared step codes, which a visual planner then converts into action code sequences executed by a language-independent actor. This design improves robustness to instruction paraphrasing while allowing failures to be traced to individual stages. It also enables efficient real-time control on resource-constrained hardware by encoding instructions only once and using compact discrete representations to keep each component lightweight. CoBoVLA achieves 91.4\% success on LIBERO-Goal, compared with 82.8\% for SmolVLA, under a matched protocol, with 17 ms per control step latency. On LIBERO-Para, it achieves 81.1\% across 4,092 unseen paraphrases and 78.5\% on matched episodes, compared with 36.5\% for SmolVLA LoRA fine-tuned on paraphrases. Without two-step demonstrations, CoBoVLA completes 48.8\% of 160 free-form two-step tasks. Finally, success reaches 91\% when instructions are correctly encoded but falls to 27.2\% otherwise, identifying language understanding as the main source of remaining failures. Together, these results demonstrate that decoupling language understanding and control can improve instruction robustness while making VLA failures easier to diagnose.

AI.tldr: VLA 在 LIBERO 上成功率高但对指令改写敏感，且失败难归因。CoBoVLA 用可学习离散码把语言理解、规划与控制解耦成 250M 模型；LIBERO-Goal 达 91.4%（SmolVLA 82.8%，同协议），单控制步 17 ms。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出 VLA 在 LIBERO 上成功率高，但对改写（paraphrasing）敏感：0.6B–7.5B 参数的现有 VLA 在 LIBERO-Para 上掉 22–52 个百分点，SmolVLA 从 83% 掉到 8%。同时多数 VLA 把语言理解与动作生成放在一起联合学习，难以判断失败源于“没听懂指令”还是“执行错了”。
AI.method: 输入是自然语言指令与视觉观测。文本编码器先把指令映射为共享的 step code（步骤码），视觉规划器再把步骤码转成动作码序列，最后由一个与语言无关的 actor 执行该序列。与联合学习的 VLA 相比，改变在于把“理解—规划—控制”三段用学到的离散可解释码串起来：指令只编码一次，各组件靠紧凑离散表示保持轻量，因此既能实时控制，也能把失败定位到具体阶段。输出是离散动作码序列驱动的控制动作。
AI.result: 作者报告（均为 LIBERO 系列基准，摘要未提及真实机器人）：LIBERO-Goal 91.4% vs SmolVLA 82.8%（同协议），单控制步 17 ms；LIBERO-Para 81.1%（4,092 条未见改写）、78.5%（匹配 episode），对比在改写数据上 LoRA 微调的 SmolVLA 36.5%；无两步示教时完成 160 个自由形式两步任务中的 48.8%；指令被正确编码时成功率 91%，否则 27.2%。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，该结果支持一个可操作的假设：把语言理解与低层控制分离，可提升指令改写鲁棒性，并让失败可按阶段诊断（摘要给出的证据指向语言理解是剩余失败主因）。但证据仅限 LIBERO 仿真基准上的成功率与延迟数字，摘要未报告真实机器人验证、延迟对比基线或训练细节，因此不能推断真实部署表现。
AI.core_method: 文本编码器把指令转成共享步骤码，视觉规划器生成动作码序列，再由与语言无关的 actor 执行，从而用离散码把理解、规划、控制三段解耦。

key_results.finding: LIBERO-Goal 成功率 91.4%，高于 SmolVLA 的 82.8%（同协议），单控制步延迟 17 ms。
key_results.setting: LIBERO-Goal 基准，匹配协议下与 SmolVLA 对比；延迟为每控制步；摘要未指明具体硬件平台。
key_results.evidence_quote: CoBoVLA achieves 91.4\% success on LIBERO-Goal, compared with 82.8\% for SmolVLA, under a matched protocol, with 17 ms per control step latency.

key_results.finding: LIBERO-Para 上 4,092 条未见改写平均 81.1%、匹配 episode 78.5%，对比在改写上 LoRA 微调的 SmolVLA 36.5%；摘要未说明 36.5% 对应哪个子项。
key_results.setting: LIBERO-Para 改写基准（4,092 条未见改写 / 匹配 episode 两种条件），基线为在改写数据上 LoRA 微调的 SmolVLA。
key_results.evidence_quote: On LIBERO-Para, it achieves 81.1\% across 4,092 unseen paraphrases and 78.5\% on matched episodes, compared with 36.5\% for SmolVLA LoRA fine-tuned on paraphrases.

key_results.finding: 指令被正确编码时成功率 91%，未正确编码时降至 27.2%，作者据此把语言理解认定为剩余失败的主要来源。
key_results.setting: 按“指令是否被正确编码”分组的成功率分析；摘要未报告该分析的基准名称、样本量与统计检验。
key_results.evidence_quote: success reaches 91\% when instructions are correctly encoded but falls to 27.2\% otherwise, identifying language understanding as the main source of remaining failures.

limitations: 摘要只报告 LIBERO-Goal / LIBERO-Para 这类仿真基准结果，未报告任何真实机器人实验（not reported in the abstract）。
17 ms/控制步的“资源受限硬件”未在摘要中指明具体平台，也未与其它模型的延迟做对比（not reported in the abstract）。
作者未在摘要中陈述明确的局限性；摘要也未报告训练数据规模、消融实验与统计显著性（not reported in the abstract）。

fdc05acdf49713136dcbf68111ac3102c6c09c5b.title: Reconfiguring Procedural Knowledge for Compositional Robot Skill Adaptation
fdc05acdf49713136dcbf68111ac3102c6c09c5b.summary: General-purpose behavior models increasingly internalize broad procedural knowledge during training, making their adaptation to new goals and skill interfaces less a problem of learning entirely new behaviors than of reconfiguring existing competence. We study this capability as reconfigurability, the ability to realize new behaviors by cost-efficiently restructuring existing components and relations under sparse governing information, where task specifications provide high-level goals and procedure specifications expose a limited set of reusable factors, leaving the concrete bindings and compositions required for execution underdetermined. We propose RecPo, a framework that represents skills task-agnostically through multiple procedure views and materializes executable skill sequences by composing stored transitions to realize task-specific changes. RecPo maintains a procedure knowledge base of skill-induced transitions, with each view exposing a reusable factor and preserving local skill connectivity. At deployment, it interprets task specifications through the same views and resolves the resulting compositional queries over the stored relations to bind skills for execution. On long-horizon tasks in an extended Franka Kitchen benchmark, RecPo achieves 91.9% ordered completion with 1.0 ms of task inference per episode across varying procedure support and task-record sparsity. Real-robot studies further demonstrate adaptation through local memory edits without task-specific retraining.

AI.tldr: 通用行为模型已内化大量程序知识，新目标与技能接口的适应可被视作“重配置”而非从头学习。RecPo 用多过程视图组织技能转移知识，在部署时把任务规格解析为组合查询并绑定技能，作者在扩展 Franka Kitchen 长时程任务上报告 91.9% 有序完成率与每回合 1.0 ms 任务推理。
AI.motivation: 通用行为模型在训练中越来越内化广泛的程序知识，因此适应新目标和技能接口更接近重组已有能力，而不是学习全新行为。摘要强调在“稀疏治理信息”下——任务规格只给高层目标、过程规格只暴露有限可复用因子，具体绑定与组合仍未确定——如何低成本地重构现有组件与关系仍是被研究的能力。
AI.method: 输入是高层任务规格、仅暴露有限可复用因子的过程规格，以及已存储的技能诱发转移。RecPo 以多个“过程视图”任务无关地表示技能，每个视图暴露一个可复用因子并保留局部技能连通性，形成过程知识库。部署时，它用同一组视图解释任务规格，把结果转化为组合查询，在已存关系上求解并绑定技能，最终产出可执行技能序列。摘要未报告相对基线的具体训练改动或实现细节。
AI.result: 作者在扩展 Franka Kitchen 基准的长时程任务上报告 91.9% 有序完成率、每回合 1.0 ms 任务推理，并在不同过程支持度与任务记录稀疏度下评估。真机研究进一步显示可通过局部记忆编辑实现适应，且无需任务特定重训练。摘要未给出真机定量结果、基线数值、样本量或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与世界模型研究而言，该工作提示：当通用行为模型已具备可复用程序知识时，把适应表述为对技能转移关系的组合与重配置，可能以稀疏规格和低推理开销支持新任务。证据边界是：定量结果来自摘要所述的扩展 Franka Kitchen 基准，真机部分只有定性适应描述，且未报告基线对比、硬件与统计信息，不能据此推断更广泛的真实世界泛化或优于其他方法。
AI.core_method: RecPo 用多个过程视图把技能表示为任务无关的转移知识库，并在部署时把任务规格解析为组合查询，通过组合已存转移来绑定技能并生成可执行技能序列。

key_results.finding: 在扩展 Franka Kitchen 基准的长时程任务上，作者报告 91.9% 的有序完成率，以及每回合 1.0 ms 的任务推理时间；评估覆盖不同过程支持度与任务记录稀疏度。
key_results.setting: 基准：extended Franka Kitchen；任务：long-horizon tasks；指标：ordered completion 与 task inference per episode；条件：varying procedure support and task-record sparsity；摘要未报告基线对比与统计信息。

7c04d3f8e07418715d8fa12f5b4973388ad44f91.title: AR-WAM: efficient streaming world-action modeling for autonomous driving
7c04d3f8e07418715d8fa12f5b4973388ad44f91.summary: Autonomous driving requires anticipating how traffic will evolve while responding quickly to new observations. Video foundation models offer the first ability, but repeated history encoding and iterative video generation make them costly to use for driving. We present AR-WAM, an efficient streaming world-action model that combines autoregressive temporal modeling with single-pass future conditioning. Because its video backbone is causal, AR-WAM updates its visual context incrementally, reusing past computation and conditioning future prediction on observed motion. We further hypothesize that future features computed from recent observations can improve generalization in dynamic traffic without iterative video generation. AR-WAM therefore obtains these features in one forward pass and uses them to condition trajectory generation, and reinforcement learning then improves the policy through direct optimization of driving rewards. With a single front camera, AR-WAM achieves 91.5 PDMS after supervised training and 94.0 after reinforcement learning on NAVSIM-v1, outperforming the compared strong end-to-end world-action models. In a dynamic setting of continuous driving, supervised AR-WAM keeps its visual history across decisions and outperforms strong world-action baselines.

AI.tldr: 针对视频基础模型在驾驶中反复编码历史、迭代生成视频导致开销大的问题，AR-WAM 用因果视频主干做增量流式世界建模，并用单次前向得到的未来特征条件化轨迹生成；单前视相机下在 NAVSIM-v1 上监督训练为 91.5 PDMS，强化学习后为 94.0。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶既要预判交通如何演化，又要快速响应新观测。作者指出视频基础模型具备前者，但反复编码历史与迭代式视频生成使其用于驾驶时代价高昂。摘要未给出具体的延迟、算力或开销数字。
AI.method: 输入是单个前视相机的观测流。相对"反复编码历史 + 迭代生成视频"的做法，AR-WAM 的改变在于：视频主干是因果的，因此视觉上下文可以增量更新、复用过去的计算，并把未来预测的条件建立在已观测到的运动上。作者的假设是：由近期观测计算出的未来特征，能在不做迭代视频生成的情况下改善动态交通中的泛化。为此 AR-WAM 用一次前向传播取得这些未来特征，用它们条件化轨迹生成，再用强化学习通过直接优化驾驶奖励来改进策略。输出是驾驶轨迹；在连续驾驶的动态设定中，模型跨决策保留视觉历史。
AI.result: 作者报告：使用单个前视相机时，AR-WAM 在 NAVSIM-v1 上监督训练后达到 91.5 PDMS，强化学习后达到 94.0 PDMS，并优于所对比的强端到端 world-action 模型。在连续驾驶的动态设定中，监督训练的 AR-WAM 跨决策保留视觉历史，并优于强 world-action 基线。摘要未报告基线的具体分数、相对提升幅度、训练数据规模或统计信息。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型的意义：流式的因果视频主干加上"单次前向的未来条件化"，可能在不迭代生成视频的前提下把世界模型的未来预测接入驾驶策略，并让强化学习直接以驾驶奖励优化该策略。证据边界：结论仅限摘要所述的 NAVSIM-v1 评测与单前视相机条件；摘要未报告效率实测数值、与基线的数值差距，也未说明结果来自仿真还是实车，作者未报告局限。
AI.core_method: 用因果视频主干增量更新视觉上下文并复用历史计算，在一次前向中算出未来特征来条件化轨迹生成，再用驾驶奖励做强化学习。

key_results.finding: 使用单个前视相机，AR-WAM 在 NAVSIM-v1 上监督训练后为 91.5 PDMS，强化学习后为 94.0 PDMS，并优于所对比的强端到端 world-action 模型（作者报告）。
key_results.setting: 任务：自动驾驶驾驶策略/轨迹生成；基准：NAVSIM-v1；条件：单个前视相机；基线：所对比的强端到端 world-action 模型（摘要未报告其具体分数）。
key_results.evidence_quote: With a single front camera, AR-WAM achieves 91.5 PDMS after supervised training and 94.0 after reinforcement learning on NAVSIM-v1, outperforming the compared strong end-to-end world-action models.

key_results.finding: 在连续驾驶的动态设定中，监督训练的 AR-WAM 跨决策保留视觉历史，并优于强 world-action 基线（作者报告，摘要未给出数值）。

摘要未报告基线具体分值、提升幅度、训练数据规模、算力与统计显著性，也未说明结果来自仿真还是实车；无法据此判断实车部署能力。

17fa3dd16e27a82eca7cc5a4f768f6e57ffe5d2a.title: ALERT: Extending Humanoid Motion Trackers with a General and Lightweight Human Avoidance Pipeline
17fa3dd16e27a82eca7cc5a4f768f6e57ffe5d2a.summary: Whole-body motion tracking has enabled humanoid dancing, athletic motions, and teleoperation, providing a foundation for capability demonstrations and manipulation data collection. However, existing tracking policies lack awareness of nearby humans and proactive avoidance capabilities, while motion substitution and local constraint-based corrections may compromise reference motion integrity and tracking continuity. We propose ALERT, a general lightweight pipeline for extending motion tracking to shared human-robot environments. Through lightweight adaptation, it integrates human perception and proactive avoidance into pretrained tracking policies, balancing avoidance demands with reference motion tracking while preserving existing motion capabilities. Simulation and real-world experiments across tracking backbones demonstrate reliable collision-free execution through localized human avoidance, preserving whole-body coordination and enabling rapid recovery of reference tracking, while retaining the ability of pretrained policies to track unseen motions.

AI.tldr: 现有全身运动跟踪策略缺乏对近旁人类的感知与主动避让，ALERT 通过轻量适配把人类感知与主动避让接入预训练跟踪策略。作者报告在仿真和真机、跨跟踪骨干上实现局部避让下的无碰撞执行，并保留跟踪未见动作的能力，但摘要未给出任何量化指标。
AI.motivation: 现有全身运动跟踪策略缺少对附近人类的感知和主动避让能力；而运动替换或基于局部约束的修正可能损害参考动作完整性与跟踪连续性。因此需要一个既能满足避让需求、又不破坏原有跟踪能力的通用轻量方案。
AI.method: 输入是预训练的全身运动跟踪策略，以及共享人机环境中的附近人类信息。ALERT 通过轻量适配把人类感知与主动避让能力集成进预训练策略，在避让需求与参考动作跟踪之间做平衡。输出是经过局部人类避让修正后的全身动作执行，同时尽量保留原有全身协调与对参考动作的跟踪能力。
AI.result: 作者报告在仿真和真机实验中、跨不同跟踪骨干，方法能通过局部人类避让实现可靠无碰撞执行，保持全身协调，并能快速恢复对参考动作的跟踪。作者还报告预训练策略跟踪未见动作的能力得以保留。摘要未报告任务成功率、碰撞率、跟踪误差、提升幅度、硬件、基线、样本量或统计显著性等数值结果，因此这些均为作者的定性声明，未经独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，这提供了一条在预训练全身运动跟踪策略上附加人类感知与主动避让的轻量路径，指向共享人机环境中的安全全身运动。证据仅限作者自述的仿真与真机演示及跨骨干的定性效果，缺少量化指标与独立复现，尚不能据此推断避让成功率、安全性上限或对不同策略的普适程度。
AI.core_method: 通过轻量适配，把人类感知和主动避让能力挂接到已训练好的全身运动跟踪策略上，并对参考动作做局部避让修正。

key_results.finding: 在仿真和真机实验中、跨不同跟踪骨干，方法通过局部人类避让实现可靠的无碰撞执行，保持全身协调，并能快速恢复参考动作跟踪。

key_results.finding: 适配后的预训练策略仍能跟踪未见过的动作。

limitations: 摘要未报告任何量化结果（如碰撞率、成功率、跟踪误差、时延或提升幅度），无法核验“可靠无碰撞”和“快速恢复”的程度。

ce21c676dfc5eac0059f4c662259eddf29829f08.title: From Temperature-Limited to Battery-Limited Legged Locomotion
ce21c676dfc5eac0059f4c662259eddf29829f08.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Supplementary video in the ancillary files. Dataset: this https URL
ce21c676dfc5eac0059f4c662259eddf29829f08.summary: On legged robots, sustained locomotion often ends in thermal shutdown rather than battery depletion: the heat of walking concentrates in a few joint motors, which overheat long before the battery is empty. We train thermally aware locomotion policies by reinforcement learning without ever observing temperature, and demonstrate this on a Unitree Go2 quadruped. We first identify a coupled 13-node lumped RC thermal network, fitted on two runs of a single robot and calibrated against the measured electrical power, that predicts all twelve motor temperatures with a mean RMSE below 1 $^\circ$C across different robot instances, gaits, payloads, and speeds. Under a sustained gait, the temperatures the motors will settle at follow directly from the gait-averaged squared torques and joint speeds. Our core contribution is a reward that drives down the hottest predicted asymptotes: thermal time constants exceed the credit-assignment horizon of reinforcement learning by orders of magnitude, but predicted asymptotes respond to torque and joint speed within a single gait cycle, so the policy learns to lower and spread heat with no temperature input. On the robot, the policy turns sustained locomotion from temperature-limited to battery-limited: with a 5 kg payload at 1 m/s, a learned baseline reaches thermal shutdown after 19 minutes (1.1 km), whereas our policy runs the battery down after 174 minutes (10.0 km) with its hottest motor 14 $^\circ$C below the shutdown threshold in a 26 $^\circ$C room; on an unloaded factory circuit with stairs and ramps, the baseline overheats after 25 laps (6.2 km), while our policy completes 47 (11.2 km) on one battery with 22 $^\circ$C of margin.

AI.tldr: 足式机器人持续行走常先因少数关节电机过热而热关机，而不是电池耗尽。作者在 Unitree Go2 上用不观测温度的策略，依据热模型预测的最热稳态温度设计奖励，使 5 kg/1 m/s 真机续航从基线热关机 19 分钟（1.1 km）变为电池耗尽 174 分钟（10.0 km）。
AI.motivation: 持续运动受热限制：热量集中在少数关节电机，机器人在电池耗尽前就热关机。热时间常数又比强化学习的信用分配视野长几个数量级，直接优化温度难以学习。
AI.method: 策略输入不含温度；摘要未报告其余具体观测项。方法先用单台机器人的两次运行拟合 13 节点集总 RC 热网络，并以实测电功率校准，预测 12 个电机温度；在持续步态下，稳态温度由步态平均的力矩平方和关节速度决定。相对摘要中的 learned baseline，核心改动是把“压低最热预测渐近温度”加入强化学习奖励，使策略在一个步态周期内响应力矩与关节速度，从而降低并分散热量。输出是用于 Unitree Go2 的持续运动策略。
AI.result: 作者报告三类结果，均未独立验证。1）热模型对 12 个电机温度的预测平均 RMSE 低于 1 °C，覆盖不同机器人实例、步态、负载和速度。2）真机 5 kg 负载、1 m/s、26 °C 房间：learned baseline 19 分钟后热关机（1.1 km）；本策略 174 分钟后电池耗尽（10.0 km），最热电机低于热关机阈值 14 °C。3）真机无负载工厂路线（含楼梯和坡道）：baseline 25 圈（6.2 km）后过热；本策略单块电池完成 47 圈（11.2 km），余量 22 °C。摘要未报告统计显著性、能耗或百分比提升。
AI.conclusion: 把热约束转化为步态周期内可优化的稳态温度代理，可能让足式机器人按电池而非热极限规划持续任务。证据仅限摘要中的 Unitree Go2、指定负载/速度与路线，不能外推到其他平台或开放环境。
AI.core_method: 用热网络预测最热电机的稳态温度，并把压低该预测值作为奖励来训练不输入温度的强化学习运动策略。

key_results.finding: 5 kg 负载、1 m/s 时，learned baseline 19 分钟后热关机（1.1 km）；本策略 174 分钟后电池耗尽（10.0 km），最热电机低于热关机阈值 14 °C。
key_results.setting: Unitree Go2 真机；5 kg 负载、1 m/s、26 °C 房间；与 learned baseline 比较；摘要未报告统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: On the robot, the policy turns sustained locomotion from temperature-limited to battery-limited: with a 5 kg payload at 1 m/s, a learned baseline reaches thermal shutdown after 19 minutes (1.1 km), whereas our policy runs the battery down after 174 minutes (10.0 km) with its hottest motor 14 $^\circ$C below the shutdown threshold in a 26 $^\circ$C room

key_results.finding: 无负载工厂路线上，baseline 25 圈（6.2 km）后过热；本策略用一块电池完成 47 圈（11.2 km），余量 22 °C。
key_results.setting: Unitree Go2 真机；无负载工厂路线，含楼梯和坡道；单块电池；与 baseline 比较；摘要未报告统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: on an unloaded factory circuit with stairs and ramps, the baseline overheats after 25 laps (6.2 km), while our policy completes 47 (11.2 km) on one battery with 22 $^\circ$C of margin.

limitations: 作者报告的数据条件而非明确局限：热网络只用单台机器人的两次运行拟合；摘要未讨论其失效边界。
摘要未报告策略的完整观测空间、训练规模、奖励权重、能耗与统计显著性。

3b52db13592590c51b2aac8c3c77e01478c9d234.title: Progress Predicts Policy
3b52db13592590c51b2aac8c3c77e01478c9d234.summary: A task specifies how the world should change, while a policy specifies what the robot should do. We introduce Progress Predicts Policy (PPP), which learns a language-conditioned scalar field through the commands induced by its differential. We obtain action conditioning by composing a latent progress field with a shared world model and read its action gradient at a fixed reference command. Continuous commands scale this gradient by a learned positive gain, while discrete commands use finite differences of the same scalar. This yields a hybrid policy without a separate action head or iterative search. Fitting demonstration progress values alone does not ensure that action gradients align with expert commands. PPP trains the induced commands by imitation and uses double backpropagation for the continuous gradient readout to shape the field's local control geometry. Demonstration timing calibrates field values on observed states without additional annotation. The continuous readout remains learnable without progress labels but these timing-derived targets support progress monitoring during execution. Experiments in simulated and real robot manipulation show that PPP outperforms behavioral cloning under a shared architecture.

AI.tldr: PPP 将语言条件下的进度标量场与共享世界模型组合，通过读取进度场对动作的梯度直接形成策略，无需独立动作头或迭代搜索。作者报告在仿真与真实机器人操作中，PPP 在共享架构下优于行为克隆，但摘要未给出数值结果。
AI.motivation: 任务描述世界应如何变化，策略描述机器人应做什么；作者指出，仅拟合演示进度值不能保证进度场的动作梯度与专家命令对齐，因此需要直接训练由场诱导出的命令。
AI.method: 输入是语言命令与机器人状态，方法学习一个语言条件的标量进度场，并将其与共享世界模型组合，在固定参考命令处读取动作梯度。连续命令用学习到的正增益缩放该梯度，离散命令用同一标量的有限差分，从而输出混合策略。训练时以模仿学习训练诱导命令，并用双重反向传播塑造连续梯度读出的局部控制几何；演示时序只用于校准已观测状态上的场值，不增加标注。连续读出无需进度标签也可学习，时序目标则支持执行中的进度监控。
AI.result: 作者报告在仿真和真实机器人操作中，PPP 在共享架构下优于行为克隆；摘要未报告任务数量、具体平台、评价指标、数值或提升幅度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出把进度场的动作梯度作为策略读出，并可能利用演示时序支持执行中的进度监控。现有证据仅支持摘要中的相对性能声明，缺少定量结果与真实平台细节，尚不能判断其泛化性、可靠性和统计显著性。
AI.core_method: 学习语言条件的进度标量场，并与共享世界模型组合后读取其对动作的梯度，直接生成连续或离散动作。

key_results.finding: 在仿真与真实机器人操作中，PPP 在共享架构下优于行为克隆；摘要未给出具体指标和数值。
key_results.setting: 任务为仿真和真实机器人操作；对比基线为行为克隆，采用共享架构；摘要未报告任务数、平台细节与评价指标。
key_results.evidence_quote: Experiments in simulated and real robot manipulation show that PPP outperforms behavioral cloning under a shared architecture.

limitations: 作者指出：仅拟合演示进度值不能保证动作梯度与专家命令对齐；这是方法要解决的问题，而非对最终系统失败的量化报告。
摘要未报告定量结果、真实机器人平台、任务数量、数据集规模及相对行为克隆的具体差距。
摘要未报告独立消融、失败案例或统计显著性。

83ba5f87ea29bbcb1ee368809645986dabac25ea.title: VoxelSBFL: Voxel-Level Spectrum-Based Failure Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models
83ba5f87ea29bbcb1ee368809645986dabac25ea.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate visual perception, language understanding, and action generation to control robots. Testing these systems produces trajectories and task outcomes, but existing approaches provide limited guidance on using these recorded trajectories to assess subsequent executions or inform policy repair. We conjecture that, for a given policy and task, traversing certain workspace regions is associated with a higher likelihood of failure. To investigate this conjecture, we propose VoxelSBFL, a black-box adaptation of Spectrum-Based Fault Localization (SBFL) in which workspace voxels replace program elements as units of analysis. Recorded tool-center-point (TCP) trajectories provide binary voxel coverage, which is combined with execution outcomes to construct suspiciousness maps using established SBFL formulas. These maps identify failure-associated regions and score unseen trajectories without requiring internal model access. We evaluate 34 spectrum-based techniques across four VLA models using 96,000 Pick-Up trajectories in simulation and compare the leading techniques against eight action- and trajectory-based metrics. VoxelSBFL obtains an overall macro ROC-AUC of 0.704, significantly outperforming state-of-the art baselines. Sensitivity analyses show that performance varies with spatial granularity and training-set size. These findings support spatial spectra for VLA execution assessment and motivate future research on runtime monitoring, self-healing and targeted policy improvement.

AI.tldr: 针对VLA模型执行轨迹难以用于后续执行评估与策略修复的问题，作者提出VoxelSBFL：把工作空间体素当作程序元素，用TCP轨迹的体素覆盖与执行结果套用SBFL公式构建可疑度图，从而为未见轨迹打失败风险分。仿真中在4个VLA模型、96,000条Pick-Up轨迹上评测34种谱技术，最优方法整体macro ROC-AUC为0.704，作者称显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，VLA模型把视觉感知、语言理解与动作生成整合起来控制机器人；测试这类系统会产出轨迹与任务结果，但现有方法对"如何利用这些已记录的轨迹去评估后续执行或指导策略修复"提供的指引有限。作者据此猜想：对给定策略与任务，经过工作空间某些区域与更高的失败概率相关。
AI.method: 输入是黑盒条件下记录的工具中心点（TCP）轨迹与执行结果，不需要访问模型内部。方法把工作空间离散为体素，用轨迹生成二值的体素覆盖信息，再把覆盖情况与每次执行的成功/失败结果结合，套用已有SBFL公式计算每个体素的"可疑度"，得到可疑度图。输出是标识失败相关区域的空间图，并可用它为未见过的轨迹打分。相对既有做法的改变在于分析单元从程序元素换成工作空间体素，且全程黑盒、无需内部模型访问。
AI.result: 作者报告：在仿真中跨4个VLA模型、96,000条Pick-Up轨迹上评测了34种基于谱的技术，并将领先技术与8种基于动作和轨迹的指标对比；VoxelSBFL整体macro ROC-AUC为0.704，作者称显著优于现有最优基线，但摘要未给出具体提升幅度或逐技术、逐模型数值。敏感性分析显示性能随空间粒度与训练集规模变化，摘要未报告具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提示"空间谱"可作为VLA执行评估的一种黑盒信号：仅凭轨迹覆盖与执行结果即可定位失败相关区域并预测未见轨迹的风险，从而为运行时监控、自愈与定向策略改进提供线索。证据边界是：结果均来自仿真中的Pick-Up任务与摘要所报单一总体指标，摘要未报告真机验证、逐模型表现或具体统计细节，因此不能推断真实部署效果或方法的普遍性。
AI.core_method: 把工作空间体素当作SBFL的分析单元，用黑盒记录的成功/失败TCP轨迹算体素覆盖率并套用SBFL公式生成可疑度图，据此给未见轨迹打失败风险分。

key_results.finding: VoxelSBFL整体macro ROC-AUC为0.704，作者称显著优于现有最优基线；摘要未给出具体提升幅度。
key_results.setting: 指标：macro ROC-AUC；基线：state-of-the-art baselines（摘要未列具体名称与数值）；条件：上述仿真Pick-Up评测。
key_results.evidence_quote: VoxelSBFL obtains an overall macro ROC-AUC of 0.704, significantly outperforming state-of-the art baselines.

key_results.finding: 性能随空间粒度与训练集规模变化；摘要未报告具体取值或趋势方向。
key_results.setting: 分析类型：敏感性分析；变量：空间粒度、训练集大小；摘要未报告具体数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: Sensitivity analyses show that performance varies with spatial granularity and training-set size.

limitations: 摘要未报告真机（real-robot）实验，全部结果为仿真Pick-Up任务上的报告，因此无法判断真实场景可用性。
摘要未报告逐模型、逐谱技术的数值，也未给出相对基线的具体提升幅度与统计检验细节；仅以"significantly"表述显著性。
部分结果未附可定位的摘要原句，或数字未出现在所附依据中，未作为关键结果展示。

95b20b8643654791379cd37fde6beadba8cef367.title: Towards Data-Efficient, Real-Time World Models
95b20b8643654791379cd37fde6beadba8cef367.comment: 18 pages, 12 figures, 1 table. Includes supplementary material
95b20b8643654791379cd37fde6beadba8cef367.summary: State-of-the-art world models have been used to produce sequences of gameplay that accord with provided user-input actions. However, high quality, consistent gameplay generation often comes at the cost of inference speed, making real-time interactive play and ideation challenging. The substantial quantities of data used to train state-of-the-art models have also made custom training of these models appear impractical, limiting many of their potential uses in creative fields. In this work we demonstrate a major step towards efficient world models: achieving both fast high-quality inference, and improved data efficiency. This is done by replacing the next-token prediction paradigm with a two-stage discrete diffusion-based approach, introducing a lightweight refinement transformer which carries out iterative masked predictions. Building on an autoregressive world model capable of generating highly consistent and complex sequences over minutes (Kanervisto et al., 2025), we achieve substantial model speed-up (79x) with a modest quality trade-off. Additionally, we demonstrate that this model can be trained to reproduce high-quality, consistent gameplay using a dataset containing approximately one day (28 hours) of gameplay data. Our results demonstrate progress towards removing barriers to the use of world models in settings where real-time inference and data efficiency are essential.

AI.tldr: 为缓解世界模型推理慢、训练数据需求大的问题，作者用两阶段离散扩散加轻量细化 Transformer 取代下一 token 预测，报告相对自回归世界模型 79x 加速（质量有小幅折衷），并仅用约 28 小时 gameplay 数据训练出高质量一致的生成。
AI.motivation: 现有 SOTA 世界模型能按用户输入动作生成一致的 gameplay 序列，但高质量生成以推理速度为代价，实时交互与创意构思困难；训练所需数据量巨大，使定制训练显得不现实，限制了创意领域的应用。
AI.method: 输入是用户输入动作（以及此前生成画面的上下文，摘要未细述）。方法不再逐 token 自回归预测，而是改为两阶段离散扩散：由扩散过程生成，再用一个轻量 refinement transformer 做迭代式掩码预测；输出是与输入动作相符的 gameplay 序列。相对基线是 Kanervisto et al. (2025) 的自回归世界模型。摘要未报告模型规模、硬件或延迟绝对值等实现细节。
AI.result: 在 Kanervisto et al. (2025) 自回归世界模型基础上，作者报告 79x 模型加速，并称质量仅有 modest trade-off（折衷幅度未给数值）。同时报告该模型可用约一天（28 小时）gameplay 数据训练，重现高质量、一致的 gameplay。摘要未报告质量指标、评测基准、硬件条件或统计显著性，也未给出与 SOTA 训练数据量的对比数值。
AI.conclusion: 若成立，说明把世界模型的逐 token 自回归生成换成离散扩散加轻量细化，可能同时改善推理速度与数据效率，降低实时交互和定制训练的门槛。但证据仅限 gameplay 生成，摘要未报告机器人任务、真实硬件延迟或量化质量，因此不能外推到真实机器人部署或通用世界模型。
AI.core_method: 用两阶段离散扩散加轻量细化 Transformer 做迭代掩码预测，替代逐 token 自回归生成 gameplay。

key_results.finding: 相对所基于的自回归世界模型实现 79x 模型加速，作者称质量只有小幅折衷。
key_results.setting: 基线为 Kanervisto et al. (2025) 的自回归世界模型；质量折衷幅度、评测基准、硬件与延迟绝对值摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Building on an autoregressive world model capable of generating highly consistent and complex sequences over minutes (Kanervisto et al., 2025), we achieve substantial model speed-up (79x) with a modest quality trade-off.

key_results.finding: 仅用约一天（28 小时）gameplay 数据即可训练模型重现高质量、一致的 gameplay。
key_results.setting: 训练数据规模约为 28 小时 gameplay；与 SOTA 训练数据量的对比、数据集名称与评测指标摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Additionally, we demonstrate that this model can be trained to reproduce high-quality, consistent gameplay using a dataset containing approximately one day (28 hours) of gameplay data.

limitations: 作者自述的质量限制：加速伴随 "a modest quality trade-off"，但摘要未给出质量下降的数值或指标。
摘要未报告评测基准、质量指标、硬件平台、延迟绝对值与实时性的判定方式，也未说明 79x 是否在相同硬件与设置下测得。
摘要未报告数据集来源、与 SOTA 训练数据量的具体对比、消融实验或统计显著性；也未报告机器人或真实世界任务验证。

09882e4c73477a23383fe84e1ad7146f4d626523.title: Where Do Human-to-Robot Transfer Gains Come From?
09882e4c73477a23383fe84e1ad7146f4d626523.summary: Human data can support robot policy pretraining, but gains attributed to a data recipe may also reflect subset size, training variability, or downstream adaptation. In an HPT implementation on a 20-task MetaWorld suite with three training blocks, a constrained random 5,000-recording subset matches most of the task-informed subset's gain over the 40,000-recording pool at 20,000 updates (3.69 of 4.29 percentage points), leaving equal-size selection differences of 0.60 points at 5,000 recordings and 0.45 points at 1,250 recordings, with wide paired intervals. Across 12 comparisons, task orderings repeat across seeds for several contrasts, but a fixed predictor built from the other two seeds trails the mean or difficulty reference in at least one held-out fold for every comparison. Neither mechanism probe shows its predicted positive interaction: task-slot mismatch yields an interaction of $-0.0347$ points after adaptation, and in a six-task observation experiment the observation-by-pretraining interaction changes sign between seeds ($-18.29$ and $+1.04$ points) while full-state pretraining gains are positive in both ($+6.37$ and $+2.31$ points). This retrospective study shows how equal-size and capacity controls, seed-level reporting, and targeted interventions change the interpretation of apparent transfer gains.

AI.tldr: 在HPT实现与20任务MetaWorld套件上重查人类数据到机器人策略的迁移增益：受限随机5,000条记录子集即可复现任务知情子集相对40,000条池的大部分增益（4.29个百分点中的3.69个百分点），且两个机制探针均未出现预测的正向交互。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，人类数据预训练带来的收益常被归因于数据配方，但这类增益也可能来自子集规模、训练变异或下游适应；因此需要等规模与容量控制才能判断增益的真实来源。
AI.method: 输入是人类数据与机器人策略预训练流程（HPT实现，20任务MetaWorld套件，三个训练块）。方法不是提出新策略，而是重做对照：用受限随机子集与任务知情子集在相同规模（5,000与1,250条记录）下比较，并以40,000条记录池作为容量参照，在20,000 updates处测量；同时报告12个对比的种子级任务排序、检验跨种子预测器的留出折表现，并设置两个定向机制探针（任务槽不匹配干预、六任务观测实验，对比观测输入与全状态输入的预训练增益）。输出是对各对比迁移增益的重新分解与解释。
AI.result: 作者报告：20,000 updates下，受限随机5,000条记录子集复现了任务知情子集相对40,000条池增益的大部分（4.29个百分点中的3.69个百分点）；等规模选择差异为5,000条时0.60个百分点、1,250条时0.45个百分点，配对区间较宽。跨12个对比中部分对比的任务排序在种子间重复，但由其余两颗种子构建的固定预测器在每个对比的至少一个留出折上都不及均值或难度参照。两个机制探针均未显示预测的正向交互（任务槽不匹配适应后为−0.0347个百分点；观测×预训练交互在种子间变号，为−18.29与+1.04个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能研究而言，该摘要提示：在仿真MetaWorld套件上报告的人类到机器人迁移增益，很大一部分可由等规模随机子集解释，且预设的机制交互未被探针支持，因此数据配方的归因需要容量控制与种子级报告来支撑。证据边界明确：这是回顾性研究、仅限所报告仿真设置、摘要未给出统计显著性，不能据此推断真实机器人或更广泛任务上的结论。
AI.core_method: 用等规模随机子集做容量控制对照，并在多种子与两个定向干预下重新测量人类数据预训练相对基线的增益。

key_results.finding: 在20,000 updates下，受限随机5,000条记录子集可复现任务知情子集相对40,000条记录池的大部分增益，达到4.29个百分点中的3.69个百分点。
key_results.setting: HPT实现；20任务MetaWorld套件；三个训练块；20,000 updates；比较对象为任务知情子集与40,000条记录池。
key_results.evidence_quote: a constrained random 5,000-recording subset matches most of the task-informed subset's gain over the 40,000-recording pool at 20,000 updates (3.69 of 4.29 percentage points)

key_results.finding: 等规模下的选择差异很小：5,000条记录时为0.60点，1,250条记录时为0.45点，但配对区间较宽。
key_results.setting: 同规模子集之间的选择效应比较；记录数分别为5,000与1,250；摘要称配对区间较宽。
key_results.evidence_quote: leaving equal-size selection differences of 0.60 points at 5,000 recordings and 0.45 points at 1,250 recordings, with wide paired intervals

key_results.finding: 两个机制探针均未出现预测的正向交互：任务槽不匹配在适应后的交互为−0.0347点；六任务观测实验中观测×预训练交互在种子间变号（−18.29与+1.04点），而全状态预训练增益在两颗种子均为正（+6.37与+2.31点）。
key_results.setting: 任务槽不匹配干预（适应后测量）与六任务观测实验；跨种子对比，摘要未报告样本量与显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: Neither mechanism probe shows its predicted positive interaction: task-slot mismatch yields an interaction of $-0.0347$ points after adaptation, and in a six-task observation experiment the observation-by-pretraining interaction changes sign between seeds ($-18.29$ and $+1.04$ points) while full-state pretraining gains are positive in both ($+6.37$ and $+2.31$ points).

limitations: 作者自述这是回顾性研究（retrospective study），即对已有迁移增益解释的再分析，摘要未报告新方法或新系统。
摘要未报告真实机器人实验；所报告结果均在20任务MetaWorld仿真套件上。
摘要未报告统计显著性检验、样本量或完整置信区间数值，仅提到配对区间较宽；跨种子预测器结果的具体数值也未给出。

dfabd0fc2c76a3aec57f449a19cd7794c6b0c309.title: Outcome-Balanced PPO and Policy-Induced Flow Rectification for Flow-Based VLA Policies
dfabd0fc2c76a3aec57f449a19cd7794c6b0c309.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables post-training of flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies by optimizing expected task return through environment interaction. However, this optimization raises two challenges: policy updates can alter the velocity-field geometry underlying the score approximation used for stochastic transitions, and sparse multi-task rollouts can yield uneven learning signals across tasks and advantage signs. We introduce an RL framework that combines Outcome-Balanced Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with policy-induced flow rectification. Outcome-Balanced PPO reweights positive advantages using task success-rate estimates and rescales positive and negative advantages while preserving their signs. Policy-induced rectification periodically fits a linear-bridge flow to ODE endpoint pairs generated by the current policy, refreshing the representation used in subsequent stochastic optimization. We evaluate the framework on simulated manipulation benchmarks and additionally study a component combination in a Real2Sim2Real task, examining task performance, optimization behavior, and flow consistency. The proposed framework improves success rates over the evaluated baselines across the simulated benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 针对流式VLA策略RL后训练中"策略更新破坏速度场几何"与"稀疏多任务信号不均"两个问题，提出结果平衡PPO与策略诱导流校正的组合，并在仿真操作基准上相对所评估基线提升成功率（摘要未给出数值）。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出RL通过环境交互优化期望任务回报来后训练流式VLA策略，但带来两个挑战：策略更新会改变随机转移所用score近似背后的速度场几何；稀疏的多任务rollout会使不同任务与不同优势符号上的学习信号不均衡。
AI.method: 输入是流式VLA策略在环境交互中的多任务rollout及优势估计。方法做两处改动：其一，Outcome-Balanced PPO用任务成功率估计对正优势重加权，并对正、负优势分别重新缩放，同时保留其符号；其二，策略诱导校正周期性地以当前策略生成的ODE端点对拟合一条线性桥流，从而刷新后续随机优化所使用的流表示。输出是更新后的策略及其配套的流表示。
AI.result: 作者报告在仿真操作基准上相对所评估基线提升成功率，但摘要未给出数值、单位或基线名称；另在Real2Sim2Real任务中研究了组件组合并考察任务性能、优化行为与流一致性，摘要未报告该部分的量化结果。摘要未给出SOTA式数字声明。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能中的VLA策略后训练而言，该工作把优势加权与生成流表示的周期性刷新耦合，指向RL微分流匹配策略时的几何一致性问题；但证据仅限摘要所述的仿真操作基准成功率相对提升，Real2Sim2Real部分只有研究设置描述而无量化结论，也未报告真实机器人部署结果。
AI.core_method: 用任务成功率估计重加权正优势并按符号分别缩放优势，同时周期性用当前策略产生的ODE端点对重新拟合线性桥流，以刷新score近似所依赖的流表示。

key_results.finding: 相对所评估基线，在仿真操作基准上提升成功率（摘要未报告具体数值、单位或提升幅度）。
key_results.setting: 任务：仿真操作基准（simulated manipulation benchmarks）；基线：摘要仅称“evaluated baselines”，未列出名称；条件与指标数值：摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: The proposed framework improves success rates over the evaluated baselines across the simulated benchmarks.

limitations: 摘要未报告任何数值结果：成功率数值、提升幅度、基准名称、单位与基线清单均缺失，故无法判断改进幅度（摘要未报告）。
摘要称在Real2Sim2Real任务中研究组件组合并考察任务性能、优化行为与流一致性，但未给出该任务的任何量化结果或结论（摘要未报告）。
摘要未报告真实机器人部署、硬件、样本量、统计显著性、消融与计算开销；这些信息缺失不等于方法不具备相应能力（摘要未报告）。

36ed4961e5d13f36cddd36b19f292edc617f8b0d.title: Every Camera Grows Up: Camera-Height Regression in Interactive Video World Models
36ed4961e5d13f36cddd36b19f292edc617f8b0d.summary: Interactive video world models serve as simulators for embodied agents: from a starting image and an action trajectory, they generate the views the agent would see. The starting image fixes how high the camera is, for example 0.15 m for a floor robot or 2.2 m for an overhead camera, and a faithful simulator must keep this height as the camera moves. We show that six recent open-weight models fail to do so: as motion replaces the starting view with generated content, they move the camera toward human eye level, a failure we call camera-height regression. Our benchmark, EyeHeight, pairs six rendered elevations (0.15 m to 2.2 m) and four calibrated real-world rig heights with scale-free multi-view height estimation. All six models lose their initial height during a $180^\circ$ turn-and-walk rollout: initialized at 0.15 m, only 0-20% of clips end within $1.3\times$ of the starting height as inferred viewpoints converge to human heights of 1.1 m to 1.5 m, whereas ground-truth renders remain within a few percent. In Matrix-Game models, homography-tracked floor motion stays consistent with constant elevation during rotation even as newly outpainted room geometry yields a higher reconstructed viewpoint. Regression grows with rotation angle, begins while the start frame remains in context, and largely reverses in SANA-WM when a $360^\circ$ turn restores the initial view. We trace this pull to human-centric video priors in which floor-level views are nearly absent: in SANA-WM, textual height cues and dense floor-disparity maps do not prevent it, whereas classifier-free text guidance during the first half of denoising strengthens it. Combining unguided sampling with height-balanced fine-tuning recovers more retention but costs 5 MUSIQ points, a loss fixed during those same early steps. Viewpoint drift alone shifts the paths predicted by visual navigation policies.

AI.tldr: 交互视频世界模型会把起始相机高度逐渐拉向人眼高度，作者称之为相机高度回归，并用 EyeHeight 基准在六个开放权重模型上量化。无引导采样加高度平衡微调只能提高部分保持，且损失 5 个 MUSIQ 点。
AI.motivation: 交互视频世界模型被定位为具身智能体模拟器：起始图像固定相机高度（如 0.15 m 地面机器人、2.2 m 俯拍摄像头），忠实模拟器应在相机运动时保持该高度。摘要指出六个开放权重模型做不到，说明需要专门基准来量化和诊断这一几何保真度缺口。
AI.method: 输入是起始图像与动作轨迹，模型生成智能体将看到的后续视角；论文围绕这一接口构建 EyeHeight 来测量生成 rollout 的相机高度。EyeHeight 将 0.15–2.2 m 的六个渲染高度和四个标定真实装置高度配对，用无尺度多视角高度估计从生成帧推断高度，并统计 180° 转身行走与 360° 回转中的保持情况。诊断侧使用地面单应性、旋转角、文本高度提示、稠密地面视差图和无分类器文本引导；缓解侧测试无引导采样与高度平衡微调。输出是高度回归的定量诊断及缓解后的保持率/画质代价。
AI.result: 作者报告六个开放权重模型在 180° 转身行走后普遍丢失起始高度：仅 0–20% 片段处于起始高度的 1.3× 内，推断视点落到 1.1–1.5 m，真值渲染的偏差仅在百分之几以内。诊断显示回归随旋转角增大、起始帧仍在上下文时已出现；Matrix-Game 中地面单应性与恒定高度一致，但新外绘几何重建出更高视点，SANA-WM 的 360° 回转可大幅反转。干预上，文本高度提示与稠密地面视差图无效，前半个去噪阶段的无分类器文本引导反而增强；无引导采样加高度平衡微调提高保持但损失 5 个 MUSIQ 点。仅视点漂移就会改变视觉导航策略预测的路径。
AI.conclusion: 这类模型目前不能可靠充当保持相机高度的具身模拟器；高度漂移会传导到导航策略的路径预测，因此评测应覆盖长 rollout 的几何一致性，而不只看起始帧。证据仅限摘要：六个开放权重模型、EyeHeight 设置，未报告真实机器人闭环或统计检验。
AI.core_method: 用 EyeHeight 的多视角高度估计追踪生成 rollout 的相机高度，并通过采样引导与高度平衡微调检验成因和缓解。

key_results.finding: 六个模型均丢失初始高度；仅 0–20% 片段结束时处于起始高度的 1.3× 内，推断视点收敛到 1.1–1.5 m，而真值渲染的偏差仅在百分之几以内。
key_results.setting: 180° 转身行走 rollout；起始高度 0.15 m；六个开放权重交互视频世界模型；对照为真值渲染。
key_results.evidence_quote: All six models lose their initial height during a $180^\circ$ turn-and-walk rollout: initialized at 0.15 m, only 0-20% of clips end within $1.3\times$ of the starting height as inferred viewpoints converge to human heights of 1.1 m to 1.5 m, whereas ground-truth renders remain within a few percent.

key_results.finding: 无引导采样与高度平衡微调组合可恢复更多高度保持，但代价为 5 个 MUSIQ 点；作者报告该损失在同样的早期步骤中被修复。
key_results.setting: 摘要未明确该组合实验所用模型与数据；紧邻上文讨论 SANA-WM；指标为 MUSIQ。
key_results.evidence_quote: Combining unguided sampling with height-balanced fine-tuning recovers more retention but costs 5 MUSIQ points, a loss fixed during those same early steps.

key_results.finding: 仅视点漂移就会改变视觉导航策略预测的路径。
key_results.setting: 摘要未报告具体导航策略、任务、数据集或量化指标。
key_results.evidence_quote: Viewpoint drift alone shifts the paths predicted by visual navigation policies.

limitations: 作者报告的模型/干预局限：文本高度提示与稠密地面视差图不能阻止回归，前半个去噪阶段的无分类器文本引导反而增强回归；去引导采样加高度平衡微调仍损失 5 个 MUSIQ 点。
摘要未报告：六个模型的具体名称与规模、EyeHeight 的样本量和统计显著性、真实机器人闭环验证。
摘要未报告：除相机高度外的几何/物理保真度、下游导航任务成功率，以及高度平衡微调的数据规模与训练成本。

8e4972ed311a7f4d17d0f67a420f35a08d83594a.title: Lyapunov-Inspired Sustained Balance on Dynamically Responsive Supports
8e4972ed311a7f4d17d0f67a420f35a08d83594a.summary: Conventional balance formulations often assume a rigid, stationary support, decoupling body stabilization from support motion. This assumption becomes inadequate on mechanically responsive supports, creating a coupled control challenge: corrective body motions intended to restore equilibrium can also excite support motion. We formulate sustained balance as a coupled regulation problem that coordinates equilibrium restoration with suppression of motion induced by the robot's own corrections. We introduce LISST (Lyapunov-Inspired Sustained Stabilization), a learning framework that accounts for how earlier actions shape the conditions for subsequent corrections. It uses recent observations to support immediate adjustments and longer histories to characterize persistent motion, with physical supervision relating the learned representation to robot-support behavior. To evaluate corrective actions, LISST uses coupled dynamics to assess both imbalance and the direction of motion. A Lyapunov-inspired criterion measures progress over finite windows, accommodating the transients required to restore balance. This physical evaluation guides joint-level policy learning through backpropagation through differentiable model rollouts. Privileged guidance focuses training on difficult states reached by the deployment policy and is transferred through distillation. The resulting policy operates using only onboard proprioception. Real-world experiments demonstrate that LISST maintains balance while limiting residual oscillations during continuous interaction with a dynamically responsive support. Video: this http URL .

AI.tldr: 针对"支撑面会被机器人自身纠正动作激励"的耦合平衡难题，提出 LISST：用长短历史观测、耦合动力学评价与 Lyapunov 启发的有限窗口判据，经可微模型 rollout 反传训练关节级策略，再蒸馏为仅用机载本体感受的部署策略。作者报告真机实验可在动态响应支撑上持续维持平衡并抑制残余振荡，但摘要未给出数值。
AI.motivation: 传统平衡建模假设支撑是刚性且静止的，把身体稳定与支撑运动解耦。该假设在机械响应式支撑上不再成立：为恢复平衡而做的身体纠正动作会同时激励支撑运动，形成耦合控制难题。
AI.method: 输入是机器人的近期观测与更长历史，以及机器人—支撑的耦合动力学。方法把持续平衡改写为耦合调节问题：既要恢复平衡，又要抑制由自身纠正动作诱发的支撑运动。它用物理监督把学习到的表征与机器人—支撑行为关联起来；用耦合动力学同时评估不平衡程度和运动方向；用 Lyapunov 启发的判据在有限窗口上衡量进展，以容纳恢复平衡所需的暂态过程。该物理评价通过可微模型 rollout 的反向传播指导关节级策略学习，并用特权引导把训练集中在部署策略会到达的困难状态，再经蒸馏迁移。输出是仅依赖机载本体感受运行的策略。与所提基线的具体差异摘要未报告。
AI.result: 作者报告真机实验：在与动态响应支撑的连续交互中，LISST 能维持平衡并限制残余振荡。摘要未报告任何数值指标、单位、对比基线或实验条件。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于把支撑动力学纳入平衡学习，而不是把支撑当作固定参考。证据边界明确：只有作者报告的真机定性结果，摘要未提供量化对比、基线与统计信息，因此无法判断相对提升幅度。
AI.core_method: 用长短历史观测与耦合动力学在有限窗口上做 Lyapunov 式评估，并经可微模型 rollout 反传训练关节策略，最后蒸馏成只用本体感受的部署策略。

key_results.finding: 作者报告 LISST 在与动态响应支撑的连续交互中维持平衡，并限制残余振荡；摘要未给出数值、单位或对比基线。
key_results.setting: 真机实验（real-world experiments），任务为与动态响应支撑的连续交互平衡；基准、基线与评估指标摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Real-world experiments demonstrate that LISST maintains balance while limiting residual oscillations during continuous interaction with a dynamically responsive support.

limitations: 摘要未报告任何数值结果：无指标、无单位、无基线对比，也无相对提升或百分点改进。
摘要未报告硬件平台、实验条件、评估规模与统计信息；方法在仿真中的表现亦未报告。
作者未在摘要中陈述方法局限（作者报告的局限：摘要未报告）。

8a79701dc9195c4c259bf5cac8e9068f91531fc3.title: Manufacturing Differential Sparsity: Planner-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient World Model Planning
8a79701dc9195c4c259bf5cac8e9068f91531fc3.summary: JEPA-style latent world models let embodied agents plan toward new goals with model predictive control, but they are still too slow for real-life embodied control: sampling-based MPC repeats predictor inference tens of thousands of times per plan, and even on high-end GPUs one planning step can take tens of seconds. We observe substantial latent locality in this repeated-inference workload: the predictor maps close actions to close latents, and inside a quantized predictor this closeness takes a form that hardware can exploit, differential bit-level sparsity. Unlike an input stream, whose temporal similarity is given, a planner itself decides which candidates it evaluates together, so the planner can choose its own references and, with reference forest sampling, manufacture more sparsity: it couples the sampled action sequences of each group to a shared root, with competitive planning quality. We build the accelerator on the insights of the rich line of bit-level sparsity accelerators and design it and the planner tightly coupled as a single co-design: the planner increases sparsity and exposes structure for hardware scheduling, and the bit-exact hardware effectively uses the sparsity that the planner creates. On three JEPA world models, our co-design is 1.28-1.80x faster than a dense accelerator and uses 38-52% less energy, and it is 1.22-1.58x faster than prior bit-sparse design and uses 16-36% less energy, with the same area. To our knowledge, our planner is the first planner that manufactures differential bit-level sparsity across its candidates and exposes its structure for hardware scheduling, and our co-design is the first algorithm-hardware co-design for JEPA-style world-model planning.

AI.tldr: JEPA 式潜世界模型用采样型 MPC 规划时，重复预测器推理使单步规划在高性能 GPU 上可达数十秒。作者提出「制造差分位级稀疏」的规划器-硬件协同设计：规划器用 reference forest sampling 让同组候选共享根动作、自行造出稀疏，位精确硬件再消费该稀疏。在三个 JEPA 世界模型上，相比稠密加速器快 1.28-1.80x、能耗低 38-52%。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，JEPA 式潜世界模型虽能让具身智能体用模型预测控制向新目标规划，但对真实具身控制仍太慢：采样型 MPC 每次规划要重复预测器推理数万次，即便在高性能 GPU 上单个规划步也可能耗时数十秒。因此需要针对这一重复推理负载做加速，而非泛用加速。
AI.method: 输入是采样型 MPC 规划过程中反复送入预测器的候选动作序列。作者观察到潜空间局部性：预测器把相近动作映射到相近潜变量，且在量化后的预测器内部，这种相近表现为硬件可利用的差分位级稀疏。与输入流的时间相似性是给定的不同，规划器自己决定把哪些候选放在一起评估，因此可以选择自己的参考基准。方法的关键改动是用 reference forest sampling 把每组采样动作序列耦合到一个共享根，从而「制造」出更多差分位级稀疏并暴露可调度的结构；硬件侧沿用位级稀疏加速器的思路，做成位精确（bit-exact）加速器，与规划器紧耦合：规划器造稀疏，硬件消费稀疏。输出是加速后的世界模型规划过程（更快的规划步与更低能耗）。
AI.result: 作者报告，在三个 JEPA 世界模型上，该协同设计比稠密加速器快 1.28-1.80x、能耗低 38-52%；比先前的位稀疏设计快 1.22-1.58x、能耗低 16-36%，且面积相同。规划质量方面仅称 reference forest sampling「具有有竞争力的规划质量」，未给出数值。作者自称是首个在候选间制造差分位级稀疏并暴露其结构以供硬件调度的规划器，以及首个面向 JEPA 式世界模型规划的算法-硬件协同设计。以上均为作者自报，未经独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型方向，这项工作把「世界模型规划的瓶颈」定位在采样型 MPC 的重复预测器推理上，并提示规划算法本身可以主动塑造硬件可利用的稀疏结构——即算法与加速器共同设计而非单侧优化。证据边界：摘要只给出相对加速比与相对能耗降幅（以稠密加速器和先前位稀疏设计为对照），未给出绝对延迟、面积/功耗绝对值、任务成功率或真实机器人结果，因此不能据此推断实际部署延迟或规划质量的具体提升。
AI.core_method: 规划器用 reference forest sampling 让同组候选动作共享根动作，主动造出量化预测器内部的差分位级稀疏，再交给与之紧耦合的位精确加速器消费。

key_results.finding: 在三个 JEPA 世界模型上，该协同设计比稠密加速器快 1.28-1.80x，并少用 38-52% 能量。
key_results.setting: 任务：JEPA 式潜世界模型的采样型 MPC 规划；对照：稠密加速器；模型：三个 JEPA 世界模型；摘要未报告绝对延迟、硬件平台与规划质量指标。
key_results.evidence_quote: On three JEPA world models, our co-design is 1.28-1.80x faster than a dense accelerator and uses 38-52% less energy

key_results.finding: 相比先前的位稀疏设计，该协同设计快 1.22-1.58x，少用 16-36% 能量，且面积相同。
key_results.setting: 对照：prior bit-sparse design；条件：same area（面积相同）；摘要未报告具体工艺、频率或功耗绝对值。
key_results.evidence_quote: it is 1.22-1.58x faster than prior bit-sparse design and uses 16-36% less energy, with the same area

key_results.finding: reference forest sampling 将每组采样动作序列耦合到共享根，作者称其规划质量具有竞争力，但未给出数值。
key_results.setting: 方法性描述（无基准数值）；摘要未报告成功率、代价指标或统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: it couples the sampled action sequences of each group to a shared root, with competitive planning quality

limitations: 摘要未报告：绝对规划延迟（仅以「数十秒」描述未加速时的现象），也未给出与所报加速比对应的实际延迟数值。
摘要未报告：规划质量的定量结果，「competitive planning quality」无指标、数值或对照基准；也未报告成功率、代价或统计显著性。
摘要未报告：真实机器人实验，结果均为加速器/世界模型层面的对比；亦未报告面积、功耗、工艺等硬件绝对指标与消融实验（作者未在摘要中自述局限）。

d4c09a7a0d6b49304aac75faaa4af4ae461b4c21.title: Similar Is Not Useful: Selecting In-Context Demonstrations by Closed-Loop Utility
d4c09a7a0d6b49304aac75faaa4af4ae461b4c21.summary: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) policies fill their context with the demonstrations whose frames look most like the current observation under frozen DINOv2 embeddings. We ask whether visual similarity selects the demonstrations that make the policy succeed. For a frozen retrieval-augmented VLA (RICL on $\pi_0$-FAST, LIBERO), we make the demonstration pool swappable at run time and score each demonstration's utility by regressing the closed-loop success of 60 fixed-size pools on their membership. On initial states disjoint from those used for scoring, pools of the five highest-utility demonstrations succeed on 66.4% of 760 paired episodes across 19 tasks, pools of the five most similar on 55.7%, and random pools on 55.5%. Utility beats similarity by 10.8 points ($p=3.2\times10^{-6}$; positive on 15 of 18 untied tasks), including on 12 tasks the policy was never primed on, and similarity-selected pools do no better than random ($+0.1$ points). Within a task, a pool's visual similarity to the test scenes tracks its success at Spearman 0.10; across tasks, similarity separates tasks whose scenes differ and falls to chance when two tasks share a scene. The gain comes from on-task closed-loop evidence: best-of-ten direct search over pools recovers two-thirds of it with 100 rollouts. Against the shipped 20-demonstration pool, utility-curated pools of five lead by 7.0 points over 560 paired episodes from two evaluation runs ($p=0.006$), and utility-ordered retrieval inside the full pool leads by 4.5 points ($p=0.055$).

AI.tldr: 检索增强VLA策略通常按冻结DINOv2嵌入的视觉相似度挑选上下文演示，本文把演示池改为运行时可换，并用闭环成功率回归每个演示的效用；在LIBERO上，五个最高效用演示的池以66.4%成功率超过五个最相似演示的55.7%（+10.8个百分点，p=3.2×10⁻⁶），而相似度池与随机池几乎无差别。
AI.motivation: 检索增强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略用与当前观测最像的演示填充上下文，但"视觉上最像"是否就是"能让策略成功"的演示，摘要指出这一假设此前未被检验。
AI.method: 输入是当前观测和一个可替换的演示池，策略本身冻结不训练（RICL on π0-FAST，LIBERO）。做法是在运行时让演示池可换，用60个固定大小池的闭环成功结果对"池内包含哪些演示"做回归，从而给每个演示打出一个效用分数；输出是按效用挑选的演示池，以及在全池内部按效用排序的检索。策略的输入上下文因此由"视觉相似"改为"闭环有效"。
AI.result: 在与打分所用初始状态不相交的初始状态上，五个最高效用演示组成的池在19个任务、760个配对回合中成功率为66.4%，五个最相似演示为55.7%，随机池为55.5%；效用比相似度高10.8个百分点（p=3.2×10⁻⁶，在18个非并列任务中的15个为正），其中包括12个策略从未被预热过的任务，而相似度挑选的池并不优于随机（+0.1个百分点）。任务内，池与测试场景的视觉相似度对成功率的Spearman相关为0.10；跨任务时相似度只能区分场景不同的任务，两个任务共享同一场景时降到随机水平。增益来自任务内的闭环证据：对池做best-of-ten直接搜索用100次rollout即可恢复其中三分之二。相对于出厂的20个演示池，效用挑选的5个演示池在两次评测运行、560个配对回合中领先7.0个百分点（p=0.006），在全池内按效用排序检索领先4.5个百分点（p=0.055）。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，本文给出的证据支持"上下文演示应按闭环效用而非视觉相似度选择"这一取向，并说明相似度在跨场景时可能有区分力、在同场景任务间会失效。证据边界：全部结果来自LIBERO仿真中的单一冻结策略（RICL on π0-FAST），摘要未报告真实机器人验证，也未报告作者自述的局限。
AI.core_method: 把演示池做成运行时可替换，用60个固定大小池的闭环成功率回归出每个演示的效用分数，再按效用挑选或排序演示，策略保持冻结。

key_results.finding: 相似度挑选的池不优于随机（+0.1个百分点）；任务内池与测试场景的视觉相似度对成功率的Spearman相关仅为0.10。
key_results.setting: 同上LIBERO设置；相似度池对随机池的比较，以及任务内相似度与成功率的秩相关分析。
key_results.evidence_quote: similarity-selected pools do no better than random ($+0.1$ points). Within a task, a pool's visual similarity to the test scenes tracks its success at Spearman 0.10

limitations: 摘要未报告真实机器人实验：全部结果来自LIBERO仿真中的单一冻结策略（RICL on π0-FAST）。
摘要未报告作者自述的局限性、失败案例或消融分析。

aacbadcf59e7559978d7ab3572612da434a3d143.title: PAIR: Bringing Household Robots into the Smart Home
aacbadcf59e7559978d7ab3572612da434a3d143.summary: Household robots often need to operate appliances, and smart appliances offer both control panels and device APIs. Existing embodied AI simulation environments, however, model appliances solely as physical objects. We introduce PAIR, a smart-home simulation environment grounded in the Matter protocol~\footnote{ this https URL }, the industry standard for smart-home devices. PAIR provides 84 smart-device assets whose functional control panels and APIs act on a shared device state, with ambient conditions that evolve in response to both. From a survey of 1,443 requests, we construct a benchmark of 40 tasks that all require object manipulation yet remain solvable without API access, with 340 human demonstrations for policy training. Whether run alone, with a high-level planner, or with an API-enabled planner, two fine-tuned VLA policies complete none of the 120 evaluation episodes. Robots rarely get far enough to use the API: even with oracle plans and API access, over 90\% of failed rollouts stall at navigating, grasping, or operating a door. With a perfect oracle in place of the robot's body, the best planner still gets through only 57.3\% of its plan. When choosing between pressing a button and calling an API, several planners go by whether they can read the panel, not by API latency.\footnote{We will release our code and data upon publication.}

AI.tldr: 摘要指出，现有具身AI仿真环境只把家电当成物理对象，而现实中智能家电同时提供控制面板与设备API；作者提出基于Matter协议的智能家居仿真环境PAIR（84个智能设备资产，面板与API作用于同一设备状态），并构建40任务基准与340条人类示范。作者报告：两个微调VLA策略在120个评估回合中完成0个。
AI.motivation: 家用机器人常需操作家电，而智能家电既提供控制面板也提供设备API；但现有具身AI仿真环境仅把家电建模为物理对象，未建模面板/API与共享设备状态。摘要未给出对该缺口的具体量化证据，缺口陈述来自作者。
AI.method: 输入是Matter协议的智能家居场景：PAIR提供84个智能设备资产，其功能控制面板与API作用于共享设备状态，且环境条件会随二者变化。作者据1,443条请求的调查构建40个任务基准，任务均需物体操作、但在无API访问时也可解；另采集340条人类示范用于策略训练。输出是可运行的仿真任务与示范数据，用于训练与评测VLA策略，以及单独运行、配高层规划器、配API-enabled规划器三种配置。
AI.result: 作者报告：两个微调VLA策略在三种配置下（单独运行、配高层规划器、配API-enabled规划器）均未完成120个评估回合中的任何一个；即便给出oracle计划并有API访问，超过90%的失败rollout仍卡在导航、抓取或操作门上；把机器人本体换成完美oracle，最好的规划器也只走完计划的57.3%。作者还观察到，规划器在"按按钮"与"调用API"之间做选择时，依据是自己能否读取面板，而非API延迟。摘要未报告真机结果、基线数值对比或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型研究而言，该工作把智能家居的设备API与物理操作耦合在同一个共享设备状态上，提供了一个可评测此类耦合的仿真环境与任务基准，并指出当前VLA策略与规划器在此类任务上远未可用——瓶颈更多在导航、抓取、开门等本体级操作，而非API可用性。证据限于作者自建的仿真环境与所述指标；摘要未报告真机验证、与其它仿真环境的定量对比或消融，因此不能推断真实家庭部署表现。
AI.core_method: 用Matter设备的面板与API共享同一设备状态搭建智能家居仿真与40任务基准，并用340条人类示范微调VLA策略进行评测。

key_results.finding: 即便有oracle计划与API访问，超过90%的失败rollout仍停滞在导航、抓取或操作门上。
key_results.setting: PAIR仿真环境下的rollout失败分布分析；条件为oracle计划 + API访问；具体任务子集与回合数摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Robots rarely get far enough to use the API: even with oracle plans and API access, over 90\% of failed rollouts stall at navigating, grasping, or operating a door.

key_results.finding: 把机器人本体替换为完美oracle后，最好的规划器仍只完成其计划的57.3%。
key_results.setting: PAIR仿真环境；以perfect oracle替代机器人本体，考察规划器层面可完成比例；具体规划器名称与任务分布摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: With a perfect oracle in place of the robot's body, the best planner still gets through only 57.3\% of its plan.

limitations: 作者未在摘要中明确列出方法局限；摘要报告的是其基准上的困难结果（如120回合完成0个、57.3%计划完成率），属于实验结果而非作者自陈的局限。
摘要未报告任何真机（real-robot）验证，全部结果来自作者自建的仿真环境，因此不能据摘要推断真实家庭表现。
